The successful path requires ffff4096 >= stock ROM8[000083b8] = 1, ffff436f == 0, ffff41c8.bit7 set, no active result bits in the records checked by FUN 00025a12 and six direct FUN 000259e4 calls, ffff1108 >= 0x89, and 6 <= ffff11ae < 0x98, which is 300 <= RPM < 7600. Success sets bit 6 and stock ROM8[00008afc].bit3 sets bit 7; any failure clears both bits and resets P030 working state. Maps 0001265a..0001268a form the five-state ladder consumed by detection core 00085a70. Completion flags from 000872d0 are serviced independently in the order ffff4241 bit 5, bit 7, then bit 6.
contract: The common readiness path sets ffff4251.bit7 in stock JK08A exactly when all listed prerequisites pass. FUN 00025a12 must return 0. Direct FUN 000259e4 calls for indices 0x129, 0x12a, 0, 0x130, 0x14, and -1 must all return 0; index -1 is inert. If ROM8[00008afc].bit3 were clear, the alternate branch would set bit 7 when ffff4184.bit6 is clear and clear it when that selector bit is set.
note: The P030 identity, gate topology, RPM interval, DTC mapping, speed and revolution cadence, snapshot payload, snapshot-match arithmetic, and operational result-latch use are code-proven. Stock JK03A contains the same gate constants and byte-identical executable code. The physical identities of ffff1108, ffff41c8.bit7, ffff2b73, and the record groups checked by the gate remain unresolved. A whole-program p-code census found no other bit-6/7 writer for ffff4251.

semantics: Misfire operating-point snapshot matcher. FUN 00082c8a calls it once for each retained group with that group's native-speed word, calculated-load byte, and coolant snapshot byte. It admits a group only under the common misfire readiness gates and when the current operating point lies inside the code-defined speed/load windows and on the same side of the 70 deg C coolant boundary.
contract: Inputs are r4=snapshot native-speed word, r5=snapshot calculated-load byte, and r6=snapshot coolant byte. It returns 1 exactly when ffff4251.bit7 and ffff41d2.bits0/1 are set; max(r4-30,0) <= ffff11bc < min(r4+30,255); floor(8*r5/10) <= ffff413e < floor(12*r5/10); and r6 and ffff3fa4 are either both below 110 or both at least 110. Otherwise it returns 0.
note: The 110 coolant-code boundary is 70 deg C because ffff3fa4 uses deg C = code-40 for positive codes. The function names no diagnostic phase for groups 0..2.

semantics: Local misfire DTC reporter called only by FUN 00082c8a. It maps ffff4200 bit 7 to descriptor index 0x0a (P0306), ffff41ff bits 0..4 to indices 0x0b..0x0f (P0305..P0301), and either ffff4200 bit 6 or the no-cylinder fallback to index 0x10 (P0300). It captures one of three retained operating-point groups, each containing ffff11bc, ffff413e, and ffff3fa4. Odd arguments retain only the selected group, arrive with caller selector bits ffff5b2b.bits4..6 clear, and set global result latch ffff5b2c.bit3 before and after DTC dispatch; even arguments preserve other groups and arrive with one caller selector bit set.
contract: Its only caller restricts the unsigned argument to 0..5. group = argument >> 1 selects group 0, 1, or 2; polarity = argument & 1 selects the group-selector preserving even path or selector-free exclusive-retention odd path. Group 0 capture is gated by ffff41c1.bit1 being clear, and even argument 0 sets that latch. Groups 1 and 2 capture unconditionally. The function returns the common DTC dispatch result when a descriptor is selected.
note: The cylinder and DTC identities come from the exact JK08A descriptor catalog. The argument polarity is operational: code does not identify either branch as a physical pass or fail phase. Group 0 is used by both 200-revolution tracks; groups 1 and 2 are used by the 1000-revolution track and by the second 200-revolution track. Groups remain numbered because code does not name their diagnostic phases.

semantics: Auxiliary P030 state service called only by coordinator 00082c8a. Its main path requires ffff4251.bit7, ffff41d2.bits0/1, zero ffff444c/ffff444d inhibits, and clear local event/inhibit states. A failed entry gate clears ffff41a6.bit4 and conditionally invokes local cleanup helpers; an admitted local condition sets the bit and calls FUN 000857a2.
note: The state transitions and sole caller are exact. The physical diagnostic phase and meanings of its additional local causes remain unresolved.

semantics: Misfire detection core: builds thresholds ffff3100..3105 and ffff306e..3070 from ffff314a/ffff314b through 000224f8, compares them in windows against offset-binary metrics ffff3820/ffff3816 with 0x80 as zero, and fills per-cylinder event registers. It also consumes five-state selector ffff2b4b, adds ROM8[0x11A28 + state] to accumulators ffff36e8/ffff36ec, and requires ffff4251.bit7 plus ffff41d2.bits0/1 for those accumulators and three counter groups. It is the sole caller of five-channel accumulation helper 000867c4.
contract: The main weighted-accumulator path retains and updates state only while ffff4251.bit7 and both low readiness bits of ffff41d2 are set. A failed gate clears the accumulators. The same common bit-7 state reaches the local helper through its only call from this function.
note: It is the only external consumer of ffff314a/ffff314b and ffff2b4b. Its six per-cylinder counters feed coordinator 00082c8a, whose sole local reporter 00084cd0 dispatches exact P0300..P0306 descriptors. The physical role of the five-channel helper output remains unresolved.

semantics: Five-channel accumulation helper called only by misfire detection core 00085a70. Its active path requires ffff4251.bit7 together with local configuration, inhibit, and speed conditions. A clear common bit-7 gate routes to clearing five working accumulators, ffff41d9.bit6, and the local sample state; the admitted state accumulates five 16-bit measurements.
contract: It has no arguments. The ffff4251.bit7 test at 000867e8 is mandatory for reaching the accumulation path. The function returns an internal offset/state value whose callers do not consume a physical quantity.
note: The five-channel arithmetic is code-proven, but the physical measurement and engineering units remain unresolved.

semantics: Misfire revolution-window producer called through revolution-phase dispatcher 0007c494. With stock feature gate ROM8[000186ce].bit7 set, it maintains two ffff444d-gated counters and one ffff444c-gated counter. Thresholds are 200*ROM8[00008354], 1000, and 200*ROM8[00008656]; stock bytes at both calibrated multipliers are 1, so completion sets ffff4241 bits 5, 7, and 6 at 200, 1000, and 200 admitted engine revolutions respectively.
note: Failure of ffff4251.bit7 or either ffff41d2 readiness bit resets all three counters. Qualified rotational-reference sample count ffff3834 below 31 and nonzero per-track inhibit values freeze rather than reset the affected counters. Threshold checks occur before readiness and increment handling in each invocation.

semantics: Calculates the crankshaft rotational-irregularity metric and is called only by 00085a70. It runs only when six 16-bit coefficients at ffff55a2 lie between 0x9452=32437 and 0x9454=33096, or within +-1% of 0x8000.
note: The journal interprets six unity-normalized coefficients with +-1% tolerance on a six-cylinder engine as crank trigger-wheel irregularity corrections. This is inferred from arithmetic and cylinder count; the trace does not reach their writers.

semantics: Two-bank diagnostic monitor with two independent Q1.7 coefficient paths. Map 00012262 multiplies signed *(ffff2bda+bank*2), divides by 128 with truncation toward zero, and compares the result with ROM16[00009070]. Later, map 00012272 multiplies signed *(ffff2bde+bank*2), performs the same division, clamps to int16, and compares the result with ROM16[00008eac]=-10000.
note: Both coefficient scales and signed-product formulas are exact. The physical diagnostic quantities remain unresolved.

semantics: One of two accessors for reserve map 0x14FF2: when the current value is zero, interpolated uint16 M is converted to 255*M and written to ffff4058.
note: The physical quantity of accumulator ffff4058 is unresolved.

semantics: Accessor for threshold 0x157D0: interpolated uint16 M is converted to 64*M and compared unsigned with param_3; the result selects setting flag ffff928b or ffff928a.
note: 0x157D0 has code-level x*64 scaling. The physical purpose of the threshold and flags is unresolved.

semantics: Composite calculation: 0x1452A forms min(0xffff, floor(M*Q/64)) in ffff9372. Separately, when the current value is zero, 0x14FF2 forms reserve 255*M in ffff9358.
note: The physical quantities of ffff9372 and ffff9358 are unresolved.

semantics: Paired accessor for thresholds 0x15172 and 0x15182 on shared axis 0x13C88. The first forms ffff9650 = (ffff35c0 > interpolate(0x15172)); the second forms ffff9651 = (ffff35c4 > interpolate(0x15182)).
note: The physical quantities of ffff35c0 and ffff35c4 are unresolved.

semantics: Integrator increment step (ramp-up): interpolated output of map 0x1462a is added to state ffff45a0/ffff45a2 with clamp [floor..cap] and written back.
note: Twin 0x1463a as a decrement step is rejected because the symmetric claim was not closed by trace. The state scale and unit are not derived.

semantics: Bank-1 A/F sensor diagnostic-word producer. It filters and bounds converted channel state, subtracts a ten-sample reference average, adds half of ROM16[0x8f98], saturates to uint16, and writes ffff2780 for exact DID 0x1225.
note: The exact arithmetic and bank-1 publication are proven. The physical A/F sensor name and conversion remain diagnostic-source claims.

semantics: Bank-2 A/F sensor diagnostic-word producer. It mirrors 00059d9a for the second channel and writes the saturated result to ffff2782 for exact DID 0x1226.
note: The exact arithmetic and bank-2 publication are proven. Public sources disagree on the physical conversion.

semantics: Selects Knock Sensor Circuit Monitor Surface B 0xABFA or Surface A 0xABBA when byte[ffff3427] > byte[0x8796], with ROM threshold 0x5F=95; interpolates shared axes 0x12BE2/0x12BEA and writes the monitor coefficient to ffff338a.
note: The output enters chain ffff338a -> ffff3334 -> ffff4204.bit3 -> DTC P0327/P0328/P0332/P0333. The physical meaning of selector ffff3427 and the coefficient unit are unresolved.

semantics: Accessor for current/prior-cycle coefficient surface 0x0C78E and subtractive correction 0x13CE8. It indexes 0x0C78E by uint16 ffff1024 and ffff11bc, combines current and retained unsigned coefficients with signed state terms, decomposes the result through an arithmetic right shift by 12, and applies 0x13CE8 to the coarse component.
note: M-32768 is consumer arithmetic rather than an independent map storage scale. A whole-program p-code scan finds no reader of ffff3080 or ffff3106 outside this function. The physical quantity and fixed-point scale of the coefficient/state calculation are unresolved.

semantics: Component where interpolation index = saturate(byte@ffff3510 << 1, 255): shll at 000a6464 doubles it, and 000a6468-000a646c saturates it to 0xFF. Prescale x*2 comes from an actual instruction rather than the catalog.
note: The axis is implicit and the catalog X Axis is absent. The physical quantity of input ffff3510 is not recovered, so scale_expr describes RAM-to-index conversion rather than physics; there is no ROM axis object. Flags from the same component failed refutation and remain candidate.

semantics: First accelerator-pedal sensor range monitor. It reads diagnostic value ffff269e, accepts ROM16[0x8ffc]=60..ROM16[0x8ff8]=964 counts inclusive, and dispatches exact JK08A descriptor indices 0xdf and 0xe0 for P2123 and P2122.
note: The exact ROM descriptor catalog identifies the two dispatcher indices as accelerator-pedal position sensor 1 high and low circuit faults. At 5 mV per count the window is 0.30..4.82 V, which brackets the factory band of 0.5..1.0 V released and 4.2..4.8 V depressed.

semantics: Second accelerator-pedal sensor range monitor. It reads diagnostic value ffff26a2, accepts ROM16[0x8ffc]=60..ROM16[0x8ffa]=1000 counts inclusive, and dispatches exact JK08A descriptor indices 0xe1 and 0xe2 for P2128 and P2127.
note: The exact ROM descriptor catalog identifies the two dispatcher indices as accelerator-pedal position sensor 2 high and low circuit faults. The upper limit is 5.00 V at 5 mV per count, exactly twice the 2.5 V terminal maximum of this sensor, because the published word is referred to the sensor-1 scale.

semantics: EVAP vent-control monitor state machine. It calls FUN 000aab54 for the path-A P0447 condition, sets ffff247a bit 7 for P0448 on three result branches, and contains a calibrated complementary P0448 status path through map 0x12870 and FUN 000b4ef8(0x2f).
note: The stock 0x12870 table is all zero, so its unsigned below-limit branch is unreachable. Independently, coordinator FUN 000abca2 skips this entire path in stock JK08A because ROM8[0x186d8].bit7 and ROM8[0x186d7].bit1 are clear. Internal metric units and the physical output driver are unresolved.

semantics: Multiplier * base pair in one component: base table 0x14a7a, u16 through wrapper 0x264cc, supplies the multiplicand; multiplier map 0x12bda through wrapper 0x26474 multiplies it and divides by 64. The instruction stream contains product and >>6: mul.l at 0xb1ecc, followed by shlr2 x3 at 0xb1ed4/d6/d8. Pivot 64 and the shift establish x/64 scaling in code.
note: Flat value 64 gives output = base, or multiplier 1.0. Base 0x14a7a has no established scale; bypass default 100 suggests percent but remains candidate. ffff41e5 selects the bypass constant versus interpolation.

semantics: Common complementary DTC-state updater. For ordinary descriptor indices it clears state bit 0, calls FUN 00025d02, sets state bit 2, and clears pending bit 6 when appropriate. Indices 0xd8/0xd9 and 0xda/0xdb use grouped handling coordinated with descriptor 0x30.
note: This helper is distinct from common fault dispatcher FUN 0007d8b8. A call to this function does not by itself identify a fault-producing branch.

semantics: P0128 state-weighted inverse-weight term accessor. It derives a nonnegative model-temperature-minus-IAT difference, combines it with ROM8[00008a30], obtains a parameter-ratio coordinate from uint16 H and upstream curve 00014e42, applies inverse weight 255-min(lookup_u16(000151f2),255), selects coefficient K from a four-state runtime selector, and writes K*floor(H*floor(B*w/255)/2500) to ffff3228.
note: Exact inputs are H=uint16[ffff35b6], S=uint8[ffff178e], M=int32[ffff3348], I=uint8[ffff2733], and V=uint8[ffff110e]. The arithmetic is d=clamp(trunc0(M/20000)-50*I+2500,0,32767), B=min(floor(d*ROM8[00008a30]/2),65535), A=lookup_u16(00014e42,00013bb8,V<<8), q=max(0,65535-floor(20*A*ROM8[00008832]/H)) for H!=0 with an explicit zero-denominator endpoint, x=lookup_u16(000151f2,00013bf8,q), w=255-min(x,255), and K=10 for S=0 or ROM8[00008a35], ROM8[00008a36], and ROM8[00008a34] for S=1, 2, and >=3. Stock ROM8[00008a30] is zero, so B and ffff3228 are always zero. ROM8[00008832], all three state coefficients, both maps, and both axes are also zero. The physical heat-transfer interpretation and engineering scales remain unresolved.

semantics: Calculated-load secondary-divisor accessor. It looks up Q1.7 divisor K from 000129d2 by high8(uint16[ffff4524]) over axis 00011b7b and writes K to ffff329f. When ROM8[0000870e].bit4 is set, FUN 0008083c applies floor((q<<7)/K), with K=0 forcing 255.
note: Stock ROM8[0000870e]=0x28 has bit4 clear, so the secondary normalization is inactive in stock JK08A. The physical quantity represented by ffff4524 is unresolved.

semantics: Initialization accessor for interpolated 1D-8 map 0x12e3a. ROM configuration byte 0x8616 bit 0 = 1 redirects the accessor to twin 0x12e32 (=0x12e3a-8) with axis 0x11bcb; branch 0x12e3a/0x11bd3 is dead. The same initializer writes centered defaults 0x80 to the two-bank angle inputs ffff2442 and ffff2443.
note: The gate trace establishes code/dead, verified three ways: C if/else, SH tst/bt, and both listings. FUN 000bd9f0 supplies the separately traced runtime writes.

semantics: Accessor for a pair of raw thresholds for byte counter ffff19aa. Bit 0 of ROM[00008616] selects 0x12A8A or 0x12A92, the result is written to ffff17f0, and 000bd3c8 checks unsigned ffff19aa > ffff17f0.
note: 0x12A8A supplies flat raw threshold 30; 0x12A92 supplies flat raw threshold 0. ffff19aa is cleared and incremented with saturation, then compared with the selected threshold. Physical pass duration and state-machine purpose are unresolved.

semantics: Intake-cam target-map accessor within two-channel CVTC dispatcher 000bd170. It interpolates cold 8x8 surface 0000b53a and warm/main 16x16 surface 0000b43a by RPM/50 byte ffff11ae and Q7 normalized-BFS scheduler snapshot ffff102c, writes cold target ffff1c5e, and writes warm target ffff1c5c. When ffff2466.bit6 is set, it applies 4x4 correction 0000ab5a as clamp_u8(main-correction+128).
note: Code proves the warm, cold, conditional-correction, target-routing, exact byte-interpolation, and raw*100/128 normalized-BFS coordinate roles. Target-vehicle replay validates the warm/main path; its coolant range does not exercise the cold, blend, or correction branches. The high-detonation interpretation of ffff2466.bit6, Cylinder Filling physical name, and (x-128)*0.5 degree conversion remain catalog candidates.

semantics: Component where bit 1 of ffff24a7 selects a rate/constant branch against a threshold comparison.
note: Physical names for 0x122ea/0x122f2 are not closed by trace. For 0x122ea, code establishes centered x-128 representation, weighting, and a local consumer.

semantics: Component where ROM bytes 0x8616 and 0x8615 select sources and additive branches, while param_1/r13 selects coefficient 0x123ea or 0x12412.
note: At r13=0 r4 retains 0x123ea; at r13!=0 site 0xbe3f6 replaces it with 0x12412. Both coefficients are consumed as x/100. The physical meaning of the corrected difference is unresolved.

semantics: Component where bit 0 of ROM byte 0x8616 selects a map family: implicit 0x12e72/0x12e7a through 0x26370 versus explicit 0x12e82/0x12e8a through 0x26474 with axis 0x11bdb. One family is live and the other dead.
note: The artifact for this wave does not include the byte value, so it does not identify which family is dead.

semantics: Second accessor for the same 0x12e3a/0x12e32 pair, redirected to the twin by the same bit 0 of ROM configuration byte 0x8616.

Transient fuel correction: two 8x8 uint8 maps, 0xAB0A magnitude and 0xB23A weight, through wrapper 0x26140. The sign of flow derivative dQ/dt selects acceleration or deceleration around neutral 0x32000000 = 50.0 in Q24. curX = byte[ffff11ae] for RPM; curY = high byte of word[ffff1024] for load.
note: Code establishes the axes. A2L identity mMITANDD/mMITANDA as Decel/Accel Fuel Compensation and physical output units remain candidate. Wave 3b rejected the claim that 0xb23a is an IIR-lag coefficient and removed the init-once role from ffff41bc.

semantics: Actual exhaust-cam timing producer, called from coordinator 000c21e6 at 000c220c and 000c2212 with the channel in r4. It returns at 000bfc50 while driver status ffff850c bit 5 + ch is set. It stores filter coefficient ffff160e = interp(00012f7e over axis 00012f6e by ffff11ae) at 000bfc70, forms the deviations d0, d1, d2 = clamp_u8(snapshot - ffff479b[ch] + 128) of the three edge-phase snapshots ffff11c8, ffff11ca, and ffff11cc from learned rest edge ffff479b + ch into ffff1c88 + ch, ffff1c8a + ch, and ffff1c8c + ch (000bfcaa, 000bfcd6, 000bfd02), takes calc = (d0 + d1 + d2) / 3 through 00021bbc while ROM8[00008615] bit 1 is set and calc = d0 otherwise (stored at ffff1c84 + ch, 000bfd66), and writes byte[ffff2324 + ch] = clamp_u8(128 + round((x * (calc - 128) + (256 - x) * (byte[ffff232a + ch] - 128)) / 256)) at 000bfdae, where ffff232a is the previous-pass copy of the output read at 000bfd74.
note: One output count is 0.5 crank degrees of the edge relative to the learned rest edge (DID 0x1164 and 0x1165, community definition raw*0.5-64 degCA). Curve 00012f7e holds 0xcd at 800 RPM and 0xff from 1600 RPM over axis 00012f6e (0x10..0x80 RPM/50), so the output is a first-order filter that passes 255/256 of each new sample above 1600 RPM.

semantics: Exhaust-CVTC target-surface accessor. It interpolates cold/fallback surface 0xB2FA into ffff1c5f and warm/main surface 0xB33A into ffff1c5d using RPM/50 and Q7 normalized-BFS coordinates. When ffff2466 bit 6 is set, it subtracts centered 4x4 correction 0xAB4A from the warm/main result before publication.
note: The normal coordinates and centered subtraction are exact. Bit 3 of ffff2468 or bit 0 of ffff5773 can substitute 0xff for the load input. The exhaust-target identity is closed by downstream ffff2327, exact DID 0x1166, and exhaust-VTC diagnostic consumers. The 0.5 degCA-per-count scale remains homologous.

semantics: Dual-channel calculation with two x/100 coefficient pairs and a selector-controlled offset-binary curve. param_1 selects 0x123F2/0x123FA and 0x1252A/0x12532. Bit mask param_1+1 against ffff14c8 selects 0x15AD0 when set or 0x15B10 when clear; both are indexed by uint8[ffff11ae] over axis 0x149CA and written to ffff1a98+2*param_1.
note: The four byte coefficients use dimensionless x/100 scaling. The selected uint16 curve uses offset-binary x-32768 representation; FUN 000c1dec combines it with ffff1a86 as u16(A)+u16(B)-65536. Maps 00015ad0 and 00015b10 are byte-identical in stock JK08A. The physical domain is unresolved.

semantics: Current RPM/12.5 producer. With ffff417f.bit5 clear, it writes floor(0xA2C2/uint16[ffff22bc]) to ffff114a while ffff24c9.bit5 is clear and directly copies established RPM/12.5 word ffff11f4 while that bit is set. The ffff417f.bit5-set branch writes zero.
note: The direct-copy branch binds the result to the RPM/12.5 domain. Signed divider 00021bbc returns zero on a zero divisor after recording its diagnostic word.

semantics: Positive RPM-drop filter and publication gate. It maintains four RPM/12.5 samples, filters the positive four-sample drop into ffff1e50, evaluates 0001202e by pre-mode RPM, retains the Boolean result in ffff257a, and conditionally publishes high8(ffff1e50) to ffff1072.
note: On the normal path D=max(uint16[ffff1f76]-uint16[ffff114a],0) and F=min(65535,64*D+floor(192*uint16[ffff1e58]/256)). With ffff2459.bit5 clear, q=clamp(ffff114a-96,0,255) indexes 0001202e, the result is retained, and ffff1072 is zeroed. With bit5 set, a nonzero retained result and clear ffff2451.bit7 inhibit publication; a zero result or set bit7 publishes high8(F).

semantics: Dual-bank MAF processing coordinator. It preprocesses exact DID 0x1204/0x1205 channels through 0003ae8a, looks up bank-1 curve 0x14274 and bank-2 curve 0x141f4, copies their outputs into the filtering pipeline, and calls 0003b252 to produce combined MAF aggregate ffff1e38. In the every-fourth-interrupt task table it immediately precedes Base Fuel Schedule producer 0003b75c.
note: The continuous AN4/AN15 -> DID 0x1204/0x1205 -> transfer curves -> DID 0x1209 trace establishes MAF identity and bank mapping at code confidence. Engineering conversions remain pending hardware validation.

semantics: Nonnegative combined MAF producer. It writes ffff1e38=max(0,int32[ffff1df8]+int32[ffff1dfc]+int16[ffff1e2a]+uint16[ffff2368]). Caller 0003a904 executes immediately before Base Fuel Schedule producer 0003b75c in the same seven-entry periodic table. Stock configuration makes ffff1e2a zero on every producer call.
note: Signedness, saturation at zero, destination, and MAF identity are exact. The engineering scale and physical meaning of ffff2368 remain unresolved.

semantics: Accessor for 1D-4 map 0x1292C: the interpolated uint8 is doubled, receives addition ffff171d in the selected mode, and saturates above at 510.
note: The physical purpose of the local limiter is unresolved.

semantics: Dual-branch per-channel calculation of signed difference d. For d >= 0 map 0x12522 supplies k for 500 + floor(d*k/100); for d < 0 map 0x12526 supplies k for 500 - floor((-d)*k/100). Results are written to array ffff40a4.
note: The physical name of the per-channel quantity is unresolved.

semantics: Accessor for threshold map 0x11C6D: the lookup forms a minimum with ffff34a2, limits counter ffff34a3, and through a comparison controls bit 0x40 of ffff41db and byte ffff259c.
note: The physical purpose of the internal counter is unresolved.

semantics: Accessor for map 0x11FBE: interpolated uint8 participates in conditional scaling and composite multiplication; the result is capped at 127, written to ffff1831, and conditionally copied to ffff2404.
note: The physical purpose of the composite result is unresolved.

semantics: Accessor for map 0x12006: a piecewise-linear lookup implements y=min(x,224), writes y to ffff17b8, and passes it into a product with ffff14dc whose zero test selects sentinel 0xffff.
note: The physical purpose of the multiplicand is unresolved.

semantics: Accessor for threshold map 0x12032: the lookup is written to ffff140f; a direct comparison with ffff110e or call to 000259be updates bit 3 of ffff247b.
note: The physical purpose of the threshold is unresolved.

semantics: Side-effect-only low-speed BFS/RPM latch update. It looks up 00012086 from high-byte Base Fuel Schedule, writes threshold ffff143e, and can set ffff41d4.bit0 after coarse speed <=2, RPM/25 at or above the threshold, status gates, and timer ffff255b expiry. Its return is discarded by 0004ed88.
note: The latch blocks later low-speed RPM protection branches. Its physical mode name remains unresolved.

semantics: Transient additive-term coordinator. On the negative ffff1a66 branch it halves the 0x12176 lookup into byte ffff150a; the nonnegative branch uses constant 64. It then calls 00052902, which writes clamp_s16(trunc_toward_zero(uint8(ffff150a)*int16(ffff1a66)/256)) to ffff2300 unless a runtime gate forces zero.
note: Coordinator 000522c4 runs at scheduler index 41 immediately before pulse precursor 0004e974. The physical transient qualifier remains unresolved.

semantics: Accessor for 1D-8 map 000122e2: lookup by uint8 ffff1077 is extended to uint16 and written to ffff1230. Consumers use ffff1230 as a term in saturated sums and accumulators, an equality operand, and a byte source after local division by 4.
note: Every cell of 000122e2 equals 170. Flat contents and downstream arithmetic do not establish a physical quantity.

semantics: Paired accessor for 1D-8 maps 0001234a and 00012342 by uint8 ffff1070. Both lookups are represented as x<<8 and added with saturation at 65535; the high byte of the sum is written to ffff15b1. Raw results are also written separately to ffff15b5 and ffff15b0.
note: 000474a4 uses ffff15b1 with coefficient 2. The physical quantity of the sum is unresolved.

semantics: Signed dual-branch correction accessor. On the signed16 ffff140a<0 branch with ffff15d2==0 lookup 0001239a multiplies -ffff140a; a raw copy of the result is written to ffff15ca and read locally before multiplication.
note: Adjacent map 000123a2 remains candidate because the positive-branch machine listing is absent. Zero contents in both maps do not prove dead control flow; the physical subsystem is unresolved.

semantics: Computed START SIGNAL state coordinator. It evaluates retained start-state predicates using engine-speed state, battery voltage ffff1188, and related status; writes the resulting Boolean to ffff4185.bit6; and mirrors it to ffff24ae.bit7 and ffff1164.bit1. The function also looks up lower raw threshold 000123aa by ffff1077, writes it to ffff1f44, and compares it with ffff11ea.
note: The exact DID 0x1302 response path packs ffff24ae.bit7 as bit 1. A structured Nissan profile names that bit START SIGNAL, and the VQ35HR factory manual independently defines START SIGNAL as an ECM-computed state based on engine speed and battery voltage that is OFF after the engine starts. The physical quantity of map 000123aa and state ffff25a4 remains unresolved.

semantics: Conditional accessor for 1D-8 multiplier 000123e2. semantics: Hardware-input and state-bit builder. It reads SH7058 PHDR and forms packed current input byte ffff1164. PHDR.PH9DR is copied with direct polarity to ffff2451.bit7. Its MCU pin is 67/B19; that physical switch identity also remains unresolved. Exact DID 0x1103 identifies ffff1188 as battery voltage, and at 0.08 V per count raw 100 is 8.00 V.

semantics: Coolant selector and downstream conditioner for the intake-cam target. With stock thresholds ROM8[00008d2e]=106 and ROM8[00008d2d]=131, it selects cold target ffff1c5e at raw coolant <=106, warm/main target ffff1c5c above 131, and blends cold + trunc0((coolant-106)*(main-cold)/25) between them. It writes the selected byte to ffff1bee, then applies mode, rate, and offset logic before writing common reference ffff2326. The later rate branch selects map 00012f06 or 00012efe and updates paired state ffff1a1e/ffff25ee.
note: The raw selection thresholds, signed truncation, and common-reference output are exact. The exact diagnostic raw-50 conversion maps the thresholds to 56 and 81 degC. Target-vehicle replay observes 1,968 samples in 51 runs where this downstream path forces neutral 128 while the reconstructed warm map remains active. The physical meaning of the later paired rate state and the mechanism that externally clears ffff25ee remain unresolved.

semantics: Exhaust-CVTC target coordinator. It starts from retained ffff2327, selects or blends cold/fallback ffff1c5f and warm/main ffff1c5d across the same raw coolant thresholds used by the intake target path, then applies mode, rate, and offset constraints before writing ffff2327 at 000c0cee.

Target-vehicle replay exercises only the warm band and shows exact steady-state convergence while exposing downstream conditioning transitions.

semantics: Periodic-table index-22 request-to-area coordinator. It calls 00073432 after ffff19c6 publication, forms local threshold ffff1734 from lookups 0x15062 and 0x15082, arbitrates inverse request coordinates with ffff1980 and state bits, converts the selected coordinate through 0x15500/0x15690 or 0x15540/0x156d0, applies ffff1702 and ROM8[0x8d8f], and clamps the result through the first 0x13202 value before writing unsigned area-domain request ffff183e. The direct ffff1984 branch is guarded by ROM8[0x870c].bit7 and is disabled by stock value 0x44; the stock-active path uses already-arbitrated ffff198a.

semantics: Root accessor for uint16 map 00015330. The lookup is converted as min(x*256,65535), written to ffff32b8, and its high byte is written to ffff413f. An alternate path reduces ffff32b8 with saturation toward zero.
note: The physical subsystem of the internal state is unresolved.

semantics: Runtime Base Fuel Schedule and normalized-load producer executed as index 3 of the every-fourth-interrupt table at 0x21818. Its fallback selects map 0x15630 by normalized coolant index. In the primary branch, let Q=uint32[ffff1e38], F=ROM8[0x8a27]=109, K=ROM16[0x9284]=26806, E=ROM8[0x88fb]=3, and N be the selected engine-speed count clamped to at least 64. The exact split multiply and quotient/remainder sequence forms fixed=min(floor(floor(F*K*Q/256)/(E*N)),0x726f9), then writes ffff1e40=floor(fixed*9163/65536). The common path forms ffff1062, unblended schedule ffff1dee, signed rate correction ffff1060, and selected schedule ffff1dec. With ffff2449 bit 7 clear, RPM curve 0x12c9e caps the corrected result before ffff1026 is written. With bit 7 set, direct 3x4 grid 0x974e supplies ffff1026 from RPM and ffff1075 buckets. Sites 0003bd1c..0003bd5a then write ffff1048=min(255,floor(uint16[ffff1026]*128/ROM16[00009534])); stock ROM16[00009534]=0x6a5a.
note: Whole-program p-code scans find no other runtime writer of ffff1026 or ffff1048. Exact DID 0x1208 identifies ffff1026 as Base Fuel Schedule, while the exact upstream DID and ADC trace establishes the MAF input. The ffff1048 formula proves a Q7 ratio to the 0x9534 Base Fuel Schedule reference; raw 128 means equal numerator and denominator. The distinct A2L entries match 0x8a27 as MAF Factor, 0x9284 as K-Value, and 0x9534 as the Cylinder Filling Up Efficiency Scaler vocabulary. The physical Cylinder Filling name and BFS engineering units remain source-derived pending hardware validation.

semantics: Diagnostic transport state machine. On the active-response path it observes and clears transmit-completion flag ffff82e4.bit7, transitions through transport states 3 and 6, sets state 4, and calls service dispatcher 0002f928. When transmit mode ffff8212 remains 0x06, this path re-enters SID 0x21 after every completed response and causes the service handler to rebuild the payload from the current dynamic-list sources.
note: The function owns additional receive, timeout, and session-state paths. The recorded claim is limited to the exact continuous-response redispatch path.

semantics: SCI transmit-complete interrupt handler for diagnostic responses. With mode ffff8212=0x04 it increments response counter ffff8213, compares it with requested response count ffff8214, and either invokes 0002f866 for another transmission or clears the counter and mode. With mode 0x06 it bypasses the response-count comparison and sets ffff82e4.bit7 so the diagnostic state machine can redispatch the service.
note: Mode 0x04 repeats on the interrupt path without calling SID 0x21 again, so this code does not establish a fresh list dereference between its finite responses. Mode 0x06 takes the redispatch path that rebuilds each response.

semantics: Big-endian diagnostic-request word reader. It reads four consecutive bytes from request-parameter buffer ffff8005 at the caller-supplied low-byte offset and combines them as b0<<24 | b1<<16 | b2<<8 | b3.
contract: Given r4=offset, returns uint32(request[0xffff8005 + uint8(offset) : +4]) in big-endian byte order.
note: SID 0xAC descriptor 0x83 uses this helper to decode its arbitrary 32-bit source address.

semantics: Nissan diagnostic service dispatcher. SID 0x21 selects FUN_000328c0 through literal-pool entry 0x2fafc, SID 0x22 selects FUN_0003235c through entry 0x2fb00, and SID 0xac selects FUN_00033810 through entry 0x2fb08; unsupported services reach negative-response handler FUN_00034114.
note: The dispatcher establishes the exact JK08A entry paths for dynamic local-identifier reads, ReadDataByIdentifier, and dynamic local-identifier definition.

semantics: ReadDataByLocalIdentifier handler. The application request is 21 LID TXM NRS. It accepts only TXM 0x04 or 0x06. LIDs below 6 return four bytes through the predefined local-ID table. A dynamic LID must be above 0x80 and equal the volatile value ffff3ee2. The dynamic path emits 61 LID followed by bytes read in order from the pointer list at ffff9820 using count ffff9920. Addresses 0xfffe0000 through 0xfffe0fff use a special pending-response path; addresses above 0xfffe0fff and below 0xffff0000 are rejected with NRC 0x12; other entries are directly byte-dereferenced.
note: Each dynamic-list entry contributes exactly one response byte, and entries are dereferenced sequentially without an interrupt-masked snapshot boundary. Multi-byte values can therefore tear across producer updates. Only reviewed side-effect-free RAM addresses are eligible for hardware use.

semantics: DynamicDefineLocalIdentifier handler. Fresh DLID 0x81 resets the output count, then parses descriptors into the volatile pointer list at ffff9820. Descriptor 0x83 consumes a four-byte big-endian address through 0002f2d4 and adds one byte source. Descriptor 0x01 expands a predefined local ID into four consecutive byte pointers. Descriptor 0x02 selects predefined 0x11 through 0x16 table families and expands their declared one-, two-, or four-byte storage. The parser requires the current output count to be at most 0x3d before another descriptor, giving a maximum of 62 output bytes for a list made only from 0x83 descriptors. Success stores count ffff9920 and DLID ffff3ee2 and emits EC DLID; invalid syntax or table selection emits 7f ac 12.
note: A non-0x81 DLID can extend the current list only through the handler's 01 current-DLID reference form. Definition performs no general side-effect or memory-map safety validation; the read handler applies only its narrow address-range checks.

semantics: UDS ReadDataByIdentifier handler. High DID byte 0x11 indexes pointer table 0x226ac and normally returns one byte; high byte 0x12 indexes table 0x2289c and normally returns two consecutive bytes in big-endian order. High byte 0x13 indexes eight-byte records at 0x229e0 and returns one runtime byte plus a support-mask byte. Exact entries include 0x1101 -> ffff1079, 0x1107 through 0x110a -> ffff2022, 0x1123 -> ffff22dc, 0x1124 -> ffff22de, 0x1125 -> ffff2302, 0x1126 -> ffff2304, 0x1201 -> ffff11f4, 0x1206 -> ffff23c8, 0x1207 -> ffff23ca, 0x1208 -> ffff1026, 0x1135 -> ffff2442, 0x120f -> ffff2756, 0x1210 -> ffff275e, 0x124b -> ffff285c, 0x124c -> ffff2864, 0x130a -> ffff2c56 with support mask ROM8[0x11a39]=0x10, and 0x130b -> ffff2c57 with support mask ROM8[0x11a3a]=0x03; response SID is 0x62.

DIDs 0x1123 through 0x1126 return the high bytes of four Q8.8-percent fuel-trim words. DIDs 0x1211, 0x1212, 0x1127, and 0x1128 select 0xffffffff entries and are rejected. Exact pointer bindings are separated from physical names and units, which come from reviewed diagnostic sources and exact Mode 01 cross-checks.

semantics: Diagnostic status-byte builder. For DID 0x130a byte ffff2c56, bit 4 is set only when ffff24d2 bit 3 is set and ffff4255 bit 3 is clear. For DID 0x130b byte ffff2c57, output bit 1 follows ffff2377 bit 0, while output bit 0 follows ffff2377 bit 1 when ROM8[0x8b2a] bit 2 is clear. The exact DID records supply support masks 0x10 and 0x03.
note: Reviewed Nissan diagnostics identify DID 0x130a bit 4 as THRTL RELAY. A homologous structured Nissan profile identifies DID 0x130b bits 1 and 0 as HO2S2 heater states for banks 1 and 2. The function establishes reported control states, not physical output pins.

semantics: Second-bank paired-sensor conditioning stage. It subtracts two acquisition words ffff363a/ffff363c from 0x0400, writes publication words ffff2862/ffff2864, subtracts learned offsets ffff561a/ffff561c, clamps signed corrected values, and writes ffff285e/ffff2860.

semantics: Paired-sensor selection and inverse-conversion stage. Mode bits select nonnegative corrected sources into ffff284a and ffff284c. Each is multiplied by four, passed through inverse pair 0x13202/0x155a0, averaged, converted through the inverse direction, divided by four, and written to ffff2848. FUN 0003b520 consumes ffff284a/ffff284c in the same two-bank ETC/airflow component.

semantics: Factory diagnostic service-mode dispatcher. When service selector ffff8491 equals 1, it calls FUN_00035856, the Mode 01 PID handler.

semantics: J1979 Mode 01 PID dispatcher. PID 0x01 masks ffff493e; 0x03 returns ffff3f2c and, when ROM8[0x8936] bit 4 is set, ffff3f2d; 0x04 returns calculated-load byte ffff413e; 0x05 coolant snapshot ffff3fa4; 0x06, 0x07, 0x08, and 0x09 read Q8.8-percent words ffff22dc, ffff2302, ffff22de, and ffff2304, calculate min(255, floor(word/200)), and return one byte; 0x0B floor((uint16[ffff16d2]*118+98304)/65536); 0x0C min(65535, 50*uint16[ffff11f4]) as two bytes; 0x0D min(255, 2*ffff118e); 0x0E clamp((ROM8[0x83d5]-ffff2022)*2, -128..127)+128; 0x0F ffff3f41; 0x10 (ROM8[0x83ec]*uint16[ffff105c])>>8 as two bytes; 0x11 ffff1075; 0x13 ROM8[0x8936]; 0x14 and 0x18 floor(ffff1d44/5) and floor(ffff1d46/5) with the bank trim through helper 000357dc; 0x15 and 0x19 ffff118c and ffff118d through the same helper; 0x1C ROM8[0x8696]; 0x21 floor(uint32[ffff560c]/2548) capped at 0xffff.

These identities establish the declared engineering scales of the internal sources: ffff1079 and ffff3fa4 deg C = raw-50 and raw-40, ffff11d4 degrees before TDC, ffff3852 g/s*100, ffff118e 2 km/h per count, and ffff1075 100/255 percent per count. PID order 0x06=STFT B1, 0x07=LTFT B1, 0x08=STFT B2, and 0x09=LTFT B2 with division by 200 converts internal percent*256 into the J1979 byte domain, where 100 percent is raw 128, and independently establishes the identities and scale of UDS DIDs 0x1123 through 0x1126. Stock ROM8[0x8936]=0 declares no oxygen sensors, so the oxygen PIDs answer negatively.

semantics: Oxygen-sensor PID helper called by FUN 00035856. It answers negatively unless the PID mask in r4 matches sensor-present byte ROM8[0x8936]; otherwise it emits the value byte, doubled with saturation at 255 for every PID except 0x14, followed by the short-term trim byte min(255, floor(word/200)) or 0xff for the rear-sensor masks 0x02 and 0x20.
note: Stock ROM8[0x8936]=0 makes every call answer negatively, so the doubling rule for PIDs 0x15, 0x18, and 0x19 is inactive in JK08A.

semantics: Bank-indexed learned-fuel-trim cell selector. It selects one of 64 Q8.8-percent cells from RAM grid ffff4b90 for bank 1 or ffff4b10 for bank 2. The 8x8 index uses current Base Fuel Schedule word ffff1024 against ROM byte thresholds 0x12592 and engine-speed byte ffff11ae against thresholds 0x126dc, with hysteresis around the prior packed index in ffff130a/ffff130b. The selected cell is written to ffff2306 or ffff2308.
note: The RPM thresholds correspond to 0, 1000, 1500, 2200, 3400, 4400, 5400, and 6400 RPM through the established rpm/50 scale of ffff11ae. Exact DID 0x1208 establishes the ffff1024 coordinate as Base Fuel Schedule. An invalid selected cell, a fault flag, or a control gate resets all 64 cells of the affected bank to neutral 0x6400.

semantics: Long-term fuel-trim diagnostic-word producer. For each bank it calculates selected learned word ffff2306/ffff2308 + adjustment ffff5648/ffff564a - 0x6400. Under the normal limiting gate it clamps the result to ROM8[0x8e5b]<<8 through ROM8[0x8e5a]<<8; fault and control gates force neutral 0x6400. It writes ffff2302 for bank 1 or ffff2304 for bank 2.
note: The stock calibrated normal-path range is 90 through 110 percent. UDS DIDs 0x1125/0x1126 return the high bytes; J1979 PIDs 0x07/0x09 convert the complete words.

semantics: Bank-indexed learned-fuel-trim updater. It derives a signed step from Q8.8-percent input ffff134e/ffff1350 relative to neutral 0x6400, an operating-region coefficient, and the current short-term fuel-trim word ffff22dc/ffff22de. It applies the step to selected word ffff2306/ffff2308, clamps the result to 90..110 percent from ROM bytes 0x8a9e/0x8a9f, and writes the selected cell in RAM grid ffff4b90 or ffff4b10.
note: The code establishes adaptive learned-grid maintenance and bank mapping. The physical meaning of the operating-region coefficient and the exact learning cadence remain unresolved.

semantics: Bank-indexed learned-trim adjustment producer. It updates Q8.8-percent word ffff5648 or ffff564a through gated signed steps and calibrated bounds, and forces neutral 0x6400 under fault conditions. FUN 00057b26 combines this adjustment with the selected learned-grid cell to form the LTFT diagnostic word.
note: The exact update arithmetic is code-established, but the narrower operating-mode name for this adjustment term remains unresolved.

semantics: Two-bank fuel-trim coordinator. Under its global enable gates it selects learned-grid cells and builds LTFT outputs for banks 1 and 2, then runs the bank-specific learning and adjustment stages in identical order.
note: The coordinator proves that parameter 0 is bank 1 and parameter 1 is bank 2 by their downstream standard PID and UDS destinations. Its scheduler entry is indirect and remains outside the direct call graph.

semantics: Control-state and fuel-trim initialization path. It writes 0x4000 to feature lifecycle word ffff2318, neutral Q8.8-percent value 0x6400 to STFT words ffff22dc/ffff22de and LTFT words ffff2302/ffff2304, and offset-neutral value 0x8000 to bank correction words ffff2310/ffff2312 during broader initialization called from FUN 0002c648.
note: A whole-application p-code census found no other writer for ffff2318 and no later writer for ffff2310/ffff2312. The fixed ffff2318 value makes the strict less-than-0x4000 feature-map condition in 0004afdc false. Runtime producers replace the diagnostic trim words.

semantics: Short-term fuel-trim diagnostic-word producer. It calls FUN 0005cbec, then normally copies working Q8.8-percent words ffff40ac/ffff40ae to ffff22dc/ffff22de. In an alternate control mode it writes one forced byte shifted left by 8 to both banks after clamping it to 75..125 percent.
note: The normal path preserves fractional Q8.8 content. UDS DIDs return only the high bytes, while Mode 01 conversion uses the complete words. The upstream closed-loop arithmetic is retained separately in FUN 0005cbec.

semantics: Two-bank closed-loop correction calculation called immediately before STFT publication. Its final working Q8.8-percent results are written to ffff40ac and ffff40ae; FUN 0005c910 copies them to the bank 1 and bank 2 STFT diagnostic words on the normal path.
note: The function contains the full feedback-control state calculation. This annotation establishes the output role and bank routing without assigning unresolved physical names to its internal terms.

semantics: State-monitor path that uses ffff1062 as an unsigned tolerance. Under its entry gates, it tests abs((ffff1062<<2)-ffff1fa4) < 128 before updating monitor state; ffff1fa4 is then refreshed from ffff1026.
note: The exact tolerance role is proven, but the monitored physical quantity remains unresolved.

semantics: J1979 Calculated Load byte producer. It interpolates M from uint16 map 0x1491a by uint8[ffff11b3]<<8, calculates q=floor((uint16[ffff1024]<<8)/M), optionally recalculates q=floor((q<<7)/uint8[ffff329f]) when ROM8[0x870e] bit 4 is set, clamps q to 255, and writes ffff413e. Stock ROM8[0000870e]=0x28 has bit 4 clear, so stock normal-path output uses only the RPM-dependent 0x1491a reference.
note: Entry gates can force output 0 or 255. A zero optional divisor also forces 255. FUN 00035856 returns ffff413e for J1979 Mode 01 PID 0x04, whose standard scale is 100*A/255 percent. This diagnostic byte is not internal Q7 map coordinate ffff102c: that byte uses fixed Base Fuel Schedule reference 00009534 and scale 100*A/128 percent.

semantics: Coolant snapshot-byte producer. It converts ffff1186 through the same 00012dea lookup used for raw coolant response ffff1079, subtracts 10 from the unsigned result with lower saturation at zero, and writes ffff3fa4.
note: Because ffff1079 is the exact UDS DID 0x1101 source with deg C = raw-50, ffff3fa4 code 0 represents at most -40 deg C and each positive code represents deg C = code-40.

semantics: Accessor for shared uint16 addition 00023824. The lookup is conditionally limited below at 46, written to ffff2eba, and separately added with saturation to ffff2c4e and ffff2c50, forming ffff303c and ffff303e.
note: The physical quantity and units of the addition are unresolved.

semantics: NATS Lock state handler: sets bit 2 of 0xffff4201 when a counter reaches its threshold; adjacent branches service related status and DTC states.
note: The Lock state belongs to registration and diagnostics and is not engine inhibit bit 1 of 0xffff4198.

semantics: Two-channel NATS registration handler: forms registered channel 0 in bit 0 of 0xffff41c1 and channel 1 in bit 6 of 0xffff41c2 from evaluator results and attempt counters.
note: Registered states are not part of the confirmed developer-immobilizer execution chain.

semantics: Evaluator for two NATS registration channels: processes counters and input-state quality thresholds for FUN_000937dc.
note: This function does not perform bytewise cryptographic ID verification.

semantics: Primary developer-immobilizer state machine. Reads bit 0 of ROM 0x8725 and updates internal states 0xffff3e28, 0xffff4230, 0xffff55e4, and 0xffff4198.
Developer-immobilizer state normalizer. When bit 0 of ROM 0x8725 is 0, it bypasses state-machine transitions and clears bit 2 of 0xffff55e4 before forming the engine inhibit.
Forms bit 1 of 0xffff4198, the developer-immobilizer engine inhibit, from bit 0 of ROM 0x8725 and states 0xffff3e28, bit 2 of 0xffff55e4, and bit 0 of 0xffff4251.
Sequential dispatcher for the developer-immobilizer state machine: BBC88 -> BC00E -> BC220 -> BC388 -> BC82E -> BC9E4.
note: Ordering BC82E before BC9E4 clears intermediate state before the inhibit is calculated.

semantics: ATU-II/APC engine-event driver and mode dispatcher. It dispatches selector ffff13b2 values 0, 4, 6, 7, 8, and 9. When bit 1 of ffff4198 is clear, it forms a one-bit current-cylinder mask in ffff13d1, updates POPCR fffff700, and calls scheduler feeder 000208f8 on the admitted path. In selector mode 9, a valid previous-capture latch causes abs(ICR0A - ffff84d4) to be written to ffff1dac and ffff84f2.bit7 to be set. Stock selector constants 9/9 make the same invocation refresh ffff84d4 from ICR0A and set ffff84f1.bit7. On the injector-event path it refills scheduled-duration array ffff224e through FUN 00054d3e and then calls masked one-shot scheduler 0002c13c with that array.
note: The first selector-9 capture seeds the reference and every subsequent invocation produces an interval between consecutive ICR0A captures. The selector producer, physical mode names, TI0A signal source, and captures per crankshaft revolution remain unresolved.

semantics: ATU-II/APC engine-event configuration driver. When bit 1 of 0xffff4198 is set, it skips the primary timer-configuration block and clears 0xffff13d1; the enabled path passes the cylinder mask to POPCR 0xfffff700.
Developer-immobilizer monitor: reads bit 0 of ROM 0x8725 and engine inhibit bit 1 of 0xffff4198 for diagnostic state.
note: The diagnostic path is not the only inhibit consumer.

semantics: ATU-II channel 1A GR1E capture handler for the bank-2 intake cam. It stores interval ffff22ca = GR1E - ffff158a, forms running edge phase ffff22d3 = 20*ffff13b2 + floor(20*interval/ffff22bc) - 60 (selector below 8) or - 20 (selector 8 and above) through signed divider 00021bbc, clamped at zero, and copies it to ffff22cd while event state ffff13c8 is 1, 3, or 5, after shifting ffff22cd into ffff22cf and ffff22d1. The pass requires ffff84ff bit 7 set, ffff8504 bit 7 clear, and edge count ffff1390 equal to 1.
note: The SH7059 hardware manual identifies 0xfffff44c as GR1E. One count of the edge phase is 0.5 crank degrees, the same unit as the bank-1 handler 0002a5cc and the exhaust edge handlers.

semantics: ATU-II channel 1A GR1F capture handler for the bank-1 intake cam. It stores interval ffff22c8 = GR1F - ffff158a, forms running edge phase ffff22d2 = 20*ffff13b2 + floor(20*interval/ffff22bc) - 60 (selector below 8) or - 20 (selector 8 and above) through signed divider 00021bbc, clamped at zero, and copies it to ffff22cc while event state ffff13c8 is 2, 4, or 6, after shifting ffff22cc into ffff22ce and ffff22d0. The pass requires ffff84ff bit 7 set and edge count ffff1391 equal to 1.
