note: The complete code-proven path is SH7058 AN1 -> ffff1d58 -> ffff2832 -> map 00012dea -> ffff2838 -> ffff3f4c -> ffff283c -> ffff283a -> ffff2736. J1979 Mode 01 PID 0x0F publishes the lane-0 transfer code minus 10 as intake air temperature in A-40 deg C, so the ECU declares the code as deg C+50; the ECM terminal and physical signal remain unresolved.

semantics: Two-lane unfiltered temperature PID producer. For lane index r4 it converts uint8(ffff1d58[lane] >> 2) through shared table 00012dea with implicit-axis primitive 000263a0 and writes ffff3f42[lane] = max(code - 10, 0).
note: The minus-10 offset matches the coolant snapshot producer FUN 0008092e, and both bytes are published as A-40 deg C J1979 PIDs, which fixes the 00012dea output as deg C+50.

semantics: Six-bucket misfire operating-range counter updater called only by detection core 00085a70. It requires ffff41d2.bits0/1 both set, divides calculated-load code ffff413e at 128, divides current RPM/25 byte ffff11eb at 64 and 160, and saturating-increments one of ffff395c..ffff3961. Failure of the low-bit gate clears all six buckets and ffff36f0.
note: The speed boundaries are 1600 and 4000 RPM. Calculated-load code 128 is approximately 50.2 percent under the J1979 100*A/255 scale. The physical diagnostic phase of these buckets remains unresolved.

semantics: Cyclic on-chip A/D sampler and PF13..PF15 external-mux sequencer. For ADDR0/AN0 it samples mux code 000 into ffff1d60 in phase 1, code 001 into ffff1d6e in phase 2, advances through all codes, samples code 111 into ffff100a in phase 8, and then clears the selector to 000. It also samples phase-specific ADDR1/AN1 values into ffff1d58 and ffff1d5a.
note: Direct reader 00028668 independently binds mux code 000 to the coolant path and code 111 to the fuel-temperature path. Exact DID 0x1103 binds the intervening phase-2 code-001 sample to battery voltage. Other AN0 mux positions remain unnamed.

semantics: Two-lane phase-gated first-order filter for AN1 samples ffff1d58/ffff1d5a. On the first admitted sample it copies the raw 10-bit value. Later admitted samples compute floor((3*previous + sample)/4), with a one-count upward anti-stall correction when truncation would leave a rising result unchanged. The output pair starts at ffff2832.
note: FUN 0003d832 is the complete caller set and invokes this function with indices 0 and 1. Bits 0 and 1 of ffff3f3e admit alternate updates; the physical sampling cadence remains unresolved.

semantics: Two-lane transfer-code producer. Under stock JK08A configuration it converts uint8(ffff2832[index] >> 2) through shared table 00012dea and writes output bytes ffff2838/ffff2839. An alternate configuration branch writes fixed code 75 instead.
note: The stock bytes select the table branch. Table reuse does not establish coolant identity for these AN1-derived inputs; the output engineering scale remains unresolved.

semantics: Conditional two-lane running-minimum accumulator. For index 0 or 1, it lowers ffff3f4c[index] to ffff2838[index] only while ffff4185.bit6 and ffff417f.bit5 are clear and the corresponding ffff3f3e phase bit is set. No admitted update can increase the accumulator.
note: FUN 0003d832 is the complete caller set and invokes both indices. Whole-program p-code analysis resolves the indexed read and write that exact-address xrefs omit.

semantics: On-chip A/D sampler for four channels. Within the exact MAF path it reads SH7058 ADDR4 and ADDR15, shifts each aligned result right by six, and writes ten-bit samples ffff1d62 and ffff1d64.
note: The hardware manual maps ADDR4 to AN4 at MCU pin 90/H18 and ADDR15 to AN15 at MCU pin 104/L20. Firmware and exact DIDs establish bank-1/bank-2 MAF identity; ECM-terminal continuity still requires bench verification.

semantics: Bank-indexed MAF input preprocessor. For indices 0 and 1 it reads diagnostic words ffff101c/ffff101e, applies the same stateful correction structure, and writes table inputs ffff1e48/ffff1e4a consumed by 0003a904.
note: Caller 0003a904 invokes exactly indices 0 and 1. The MAF and bank identities are exact; the correction's physical meaning remains unresolved.

semantics: Bank-indexed MAF working-value refresh. It copies transfer outputs ffff1054/ffff1056 to ffff1058/ffff105a before the per-bank filter and total-MAF calculations.
note: Caller 0003a904 invokes exactly indices 0 and 1.

semantics: Two-bank first-order MAF filter. For indices 0 and 1 it writes ffff1df0/ffff1df2 from working curve values ffff1058/ffff105a. A mode bit selects direct copy or weighted update and code applies a one-count anti-stall correction when truncation would leave a changing value unchanged.
note: Caller 0003a904 invokes exactly indices 0 and 1. The filter coefficient's physical time constant remains unresolved.

semantics: Stateful per-bank MAF contribution producer. For indices 0 and 1 it reads filtered quantities ffff1df0/ffff1df2, applies bounded corrections, and writes signed 32-bit contributions ffff1df8/ffff1dfc consumed by combined-MAF producer 0003b252.
note: The per-bank MAF role is exact. The physical meanings of the stateful correction terms remain unresolved.

semantics: Per-bank corrected MAF helper. For a selected bank it adds signed common correction ffff1e2a and unsigned auxiliary contribution ffff2368 to the bank's signed 32-bit contribution ffff1df8/ffff1dfc, clamps negative results to zero, and writes the indexed result. Stock configuration makes ffff1e2a zero on every producer call.
note: The destination's downstream role and the physical meaning of ffff2368 remain unresolved.

semantics: Stock-resolved common signed MAF-correction producer. Let A=(ROM8[0x86f9]&0x20)!=0, B=(ROM8[0x8b3f]&1)!=0, C=ROM8[0x8782], U=uint8[ffff1e73], and S=int8[ffff56ba]. If !A&&!B it writes zero; if !A&&B it writes floor(C*S/32); if A&&B it preserves the prior word; otherwise it writes floor(C*(U-123)/32) for 5<=U<=122, floor(C*(U-133)/32) for 133<=U<=250, and zero outside both ranges. Stock A=false and B=false, so every call writes zero.
note: Five SH-2E arithmetic right shifts implement floor division by 32 for negative products. The alternative mode's physical meaning and engineering scale remain unresolved.

semantics: Combined MAF diagnostic producer. It forms S=uint16[ffff1058]+uint16[ffff105a]+uint16[ffff2368], applies a first-order filter selected by ROM8[0x8a08]=1 through left-shift helper 000221bc, saturates the result into ffff1df4, and writes ffff105c=max(ffff1df4-ROM16[0x93ce],0). FUN 0003c3ac converts ffff105c to exact DID 0x1209.
note: The mass-airflow identity is exact through DID 0x1209. The community-measured raw/100 g/s conversion is the working candidate; hardware validation remains required.

semantics: Bank-indexed MAF diagnostic-word publisher. It reads ten-bit AN4/AN15 samples ffff1d62/ffff1d64, invokes 000671d8 to apply shared Q1.15 coefficient ffff4970 with uint16 saturation, adds one when the raw sample is full-scale 0x03ff, and writes ffff101c/ffff101e.
note: FUN 0003c3ac is the complete caller and invokes indices 0 and 1. A whole-program p-code scan found no other writer candidates for ffff101c/ffff101e. The full-scale increment makes the published span 0..1024 counts rather than 0..1023, so the saturated reading is one count above the last converted value.

semantics: Bank-indexed raw MAF ADC snapshot copier. It copies ffff1d62/ffff1d64 to ffff1a3e/ffff1a40 after the diagnostic words are refreshed.
note: FUN 0003c3ac invokes exactly indices 0 and 1. The downstream role of the raw snapshots remains unresolved.

semantics: Dual-bank MAF diagnostic coordinator referenced by scheduler table 0x217f8. It publishes DID 0x1204/0x1205 words through two calls to 0003c408, snapshots both raw ADC samples through 0003c45c, writes combined MASS AIRFLOW word ffff3852=min(65535,floor(ROM8[0x83ec]*ffff105c/256)), and publishes extension-record-0x129 byte1.bit7 to ffff2449.bit7.
note: Record 0x129 byte1 is the OR of exact P0101/P0102/P0103 and P010B/P010C/P010D runtime-record byte1 values. Stock factor 0x69 is 105. Engineering conversions require hardware validation.

semantics: Guard for shared Q1.15 trim coefficient ffff4970 of the MAF diagnostic words and the battery-voltage byte. Unless ffff4252 bit 3 bypasses the check, values outside inclusive range 0x7900..0x8700 are replaced with stock ROM16[0x92be]=0x8000.
note: In-range non-stock values come from calibration stage 0006635c and from import step 00068724, which reads configuration key 0x7f. The guard range is a trim of plus or minus 5.5 percent around unity.

semantics: Unsigned Q1.15 scaler used for both MAF sensor channels and for the battery-voltage byte. It calculates min(65535, floor(uint16(input)*uint16[ffff4970]/32768)) and writes the uint16 result through its output pointer.
note: Stock ffff4970=0x8000 makes the transform an identity before the separate full-scale correction in 0003c408.

semantics: SCI2-backed two-byte read primitive. For each of byte addresses 2*key and 2*key+1 it writes command 0x03, sends the address through TDR2, clocks one response byte with 0xff, and combines the two RDR2 bytes into a big-endian uint16 result.
note: The SH7058 hardware manual establishes the SCI2 register identities. The external peer and stored quantity are not identified by the transaction mechanics.

semantics: Stable 16-bit read wrapper. It calls 00066bd0 twice per attempt and returns only equal consecutive values, for up to ROM8[0x8a37] attempts. Success clears ffff41b9.bit0; exhaustion sets the bit and returns zero. Stock retry count is three.
note: The wrapper proves consistency checking and error signaling, not the external peer's physical identity.

semantics: Mixed runtime-state coordinator. One conditional branch copies byte ffff99de to common-correction source ffff56ba when its enclosing mode and status conditions both pass.
note: Only the ffff56ba assignment is characterized here; the broad function and the physical source of ffff99de remain unresolved.

semantics: Configuration-word import step. While ffff41b9.bit0 is clear it reads keys 0x74 and 0x7e through stable wrapper 0006727c, rechecks the error bit, stores the high byte of the 0x74 result in ffff29c6 and its low byte in ffff316a, and stores the high byte of the 0x7e result in ffff56ba.
note: ffff29c6 is the nonvolatile timing offset selected by 0004aad0 within -5..0 crank degrees. The meaning of ffff56ba and the SCI2 peer remain unresolved; stock common-correction mode does not consume it.

semantics: ADC2-to-RAM acquisition initializer using DMAC channel 2. With ROM8[0x8b3d].bit7 set, it programs SAR2 to ADC2 ADDR24 at fffff840 or ADDR28 at fffff848, DAR2 to byte buffer ffff86cc or ffff874c selected by ffff20c0, DMATCR2 to 128, and CHCR2 to 0x010d110d. The control word selects ADC2 requests, source reload, incrementing byte destinations, completion interrupt, and channel enable.
note: The two 128-byte destination ranges are ffff86cc..ffff874b and ffff874c..ffff87cb; neither overlaps ffff2368. The ADC2 channel selection and DMAC control fields follow the SH7058 hardware manual.

semantics: ADC2 DMAC channel-2 completion interrupt handler. It disables and rearms CHCR2, toggles the destination-buffer selector ffff20c0, programs the next 128-byte transfer to ffff86cc or ffff874c from ADC2 ADDR24 or ADDR28, processes the completed buffer through 0004928c, restores all saved registers, and returns with RTE.
note: All recovered programmed destinations remain within ffff86cc..ffff87cb and cannot produce ffff2368.

semantics: ADC2 DMAC acquisition finalizer. It disables CHCR2, derives a completed four-byte-group count as floor((128-DMATCR2)/4), invokes 0004a238, clears the local accumulation words, and publishes acquisition count and status fields.
note: The exact acquisition mechanics are established; the physical purpose of the accumulated ADC2 channels remains unresolved.

semantics: Two-mode nonlinear transition controller using reciprocal pair 00011d24/0001199e. With ffff2482.bit2 clear it converts a nonnegative signed-byte difference through F, combines the result with weight ffff186a in the F-domain, inverse-converts through G, and writes bounded Q8 state ffff23c2. With bit2 set it evaluates F at two separated coordinates, writes ffff14c0 and ffff2ec3, decrements ffff23c2 under its gates, and clears bit2 when the state reaches zero.
note: Periodic table index 65 reaches this function through 00065434 after index 63 map selection and index 64 knock coordination. Stock ROM8[0x8710].bit5 makes the high byte of ffff23c2 an input to 0004d99c. The normal-path difference is max(ffff23f1-ffff2404,0) and the upper limit is ffff2404-ROM8[0x8240]=ffff2404+7, both in crank degrees; the Q8 high byte reaches the final coordinate through ffff2336 and ffff11f9 with coefficient 1.

semantics: Forward-blend-inverse correction through 00011d24/0001199e. On the admitted path, x=clamp_u8(s8[ffff23f1]-s8[ffff2404]), a=F(x), y=floor((0xff00-u8[ffff1862]*(256-a))/256), and ffff1346=clamp_s8(s8[ffff23f1]-G(y)).
note: F(z)=interp_u8(00011d24,axis 0001199e,z) and G(q)=interp_u8(0001199e,axis 00011d24,q). Entry is suppressed only by the exact ROM/runtime gate at 000646a8-000646c2. The physical quantity and engineering scale are unresolved.

semantics: First signed-state channel using forward nonlinear table 00011d24. When ROM8[00008710].bit5 is clear, it forms bounded x0 and x1 from s8[ffff23f1]-s8[ffff2404], channel byte ffff11c2, and unsigned corrections ffff12df/ffff15ea, then calculates trunc0(s16[ffff18cc]*(256-F(x1))/(256-F(x0))). When bit5 is set, an equality branch copies ffff18ce; the other branch calculates trunc0(s16[ffff18cc]*(256-F(x))/256). The saturated signed result is written to ffff18d4.
note: F(z)=interp_u8(00011d24,axis 0001199e,z). Denominators are nonzero because the table maximum is 179, so 256-F(x)>=77. The exact channel arithmetic is established; the physical state and units are unresolved.

semantics: Second signed-state channel using forward nonlinear table 00011d24. When ROM8[00008710].bit5 is clear, it forms bounded x0 and x1 from s8[ffff23f1]-s8[ffff2404], channel byte ffff11c1, and unsigned corrections ffff12df/ffff15ea, then calculates trunc0(s16[ffff18cc]*(256-F(x1))/(256-F(x0))). When bit5 is set, it calculates trunc0(s16[ffff18cc]*(256-F(clamp_u8(s8[ffff23f1]-s8[ffff11a2])))/256). The saturated signed result is written to ffff18ce.
note: F(z)=interp_u8(00011d24,axis 0001199e,z). Denominators are nonzero because the table maximum is 179, so 256-F(x)>=77. The exact channel arithmetic is established; the physical state and units are unresolved.

semantics: Dual signed-endpoint surface evaluator. It selects y=ffff10d2 or max(ffff10d2,ffff10e2) through ffff4255.bit7, uses x=ffff1210, interpolates 000171c8 and 00016fc8, decodes each uint16 result as raw-32768, and writes endpoints ffff1cfc and ffff1cfe.
note: Both surfaces and their axes are byte-identical in stock JK08A. Code proves the signed endpoint representation and selection; the physical quantity is unresolved.

semantics: Saturating Q0.16 blend-weight updater for ffff1d0c. It subtracts ROM16[000162dc]=300 toward zero when ffff245c.bit2 is clear and adds 300 toward 65535 when the bit is set.
note: The update direction and saturation are exact. The condition that controls ffff245c.bit2 is unresolved.

semantics: Q0.16 signed-endpoint blend coordinator. It calls 00074028 to produce A=ffff1cfc and B=ffff1cfe, updates weight w=ffff1d0c through 000740ae, and writes ffff1cf6 as A for w=0, B for w=65535, or floor(((65536-w)*A+w*B)/65536) otherwise.
note: The endpoint maps are identical in stock JK08A, so the weight does not change the stock result. The physical quantity and engineering unit are unresolved.

semantics: Conditional dual signed-endpoint surface evaluator. It selects y=ffff10d2 or max(ffff10d2,ffff10e2) through ffff4255.bit7, uses x=ffff1210, interpolates 0000de8e and 0000e08e, decodes each uint16 result as raw-32768, and writes endpoints ffff18ec and ffff18ee.
note: Both surfaces and their axes are byte-identical in stock JK08A. Code proves the signed endpoint representation and selection; the physical quantity is unresolved.

semantics: Saturating Q0.16 blend-weight updater for ffff2420. It subtracts ROM16[000090a0]=300 toward zero when ffff245c.bit2 is clear and adds 300 toward 65535 when the bit is set.
note: The update direction and saturation are exact. The condition that controls ffff245c.bit2 is unresolved.

semantics: ROM-gated Q0.16 signed-endpoint blend coordinator. On the enabled path it calls 0007604c to produce A=ffff18ec and B=ffff18ee, updates weight w=ffff2420 through 000760d2, and writes ffff18e6 as A for w=0, B for w=65535, or floor(((65536-w)*A+w*B)/65536) otherwise.
note: Stock ROM8[00008b3f].bit7 is clear, but ROM8[000089fa].bit5 is also clear and skips the entire evaluation and blend. The endpoint maps are identical if the path is enabled. The physical quantity and engineering unit are unresolved.

semantics: ROM-gated inverse signed-surface evaluator. It selects y=ffff1152 or max(ffff1152,ffff1162), interpolates each row of 0000de8e across axis 00013d34, and uses the resulting 16-word stack vector as the search axis for target ffff18ea or ffff3394. Identity table 00013d14 returns coordinate ffff1f60. The bit5 path repeats the operation over 0000e28e into ffff1e7a, can blend the two coordinates through ffff3e72/255 into ffff1f5e, and publishes min(800,floor(selected_coordinate*800/727)) as ffff2816. The disabled path copies ffff2a7a to ffff2816.
note: Entry requires ROM8[000089fa].bit5 or ROM8[00008b29].bit6. Both bits are clear in stock JK08A, so only the direct ffff2a7a copy executes. The first target is signed16[ffff18ea]+32768 when bit5 is set and signed16[ffff3394]+32768 when only bit6 enables the path; the second target is signed16[ffff18ea]+32768. Every cell of 0000e28e is zero in stock. JK03A preserves this exact function and address layout; VQ35HR JK00D preserves the two-surface algorithm, while VQ37VHR 1ND0A preserves a simplified one-surface homolog and the same 727/800 range conversion. The physical quantity is unresolved.

semantics: Gated Q0.16 blend of signed states ffff18e8 and ffff18e6. When all three gates admit the blend, ffff2422 selects A=ffff18e8 at 0, B=ffff18e6 at 65535, or floor(((65536-w)*A+w*B)/65536); otherwise A is copied. The result is written to ffff18f4.
note: FUN 00074c82 and FUN 00074b68 control weight ffff2422. Code proves the blend and gates; the physical quantity is unresolved.

semantics: Per-bank exhaust-VTC control-mode state machine and bounded controller-state builder. Mode byte ffff1b1c+param_1 moves between 0, 1, and 2 under ffff248b bits 0/2 and the bank bit of ffff1246. With stock ROM8[00008615] bit 3 set it forms P=floor(floor(u16[ffff1b18+2*param_1]*ROM16[00009212|00009214])*gain*2/625); with the bit clear it forms P=(u16[ffff1a86+2*param_1]+u16[ffff1a98+2*param_1]-65536)*65536+int32[ffff1a90+4*param_1]-0x08000000 scaled by gain/128. Gain is curve 0001205a over axis 00012850 at ffff2772, stored in ffff143a. P is clamped to 0..0x04000000 and stored at ffff1aa4+4*param_1.
note: The subtraction of 65536 jointly decodes the two uint16 words as centered offset-binary terms. The physical meaning of ffff248b bits 0 and 2 and of coordinate ffff2772 remains unresolved; P feeds duty stage 000c2040.

semantics: Subsystem initializer that writes neutral offset-binary value 0x8000 to both channel pairs ffff1a86/ffff1a88 and ffff1a98/ffff1a9a, while initializing their associated 32-bit states. It also initializes actual exhaust-cam timing bytes ffff2324 (000bcf7e) and ffff2325 (000bd046) and rest-edge deviations ffff1376 (000bcfb6) and ffff1377 (000bd04a) to 0x80.
note: The 0x8000 stores independently establish the neutral representation used by FUN 000c0d90 and FUN 000c1dec. The 0x80 initializations of the exhaust-cam bytes bind the initializer to the exhaust-VTC subsystem.

semantics: Dual-channel coordinate conditioner for conversion curve 000148fa. It looks up Q1.7 divisor C from 00012292 by high8(uint16[ffff4524]) over axis 00011b47. For each selected source X, it forms d=sat_s16(X-880). When C is nonzero and the range gates pass, the returned coordinate is max(0,880+sat_s16(trunc0(128*d/C))); otherwise the original X is returned.
note: ROM8[00008978].bit3 selects the source pair: set uses ffff2882/ffff2884; clear, as in stock 0xa0, uses 2*ffff267c and 2*ffff267e. The physical sensor quantity and engineering scale of the coordinates are unresolved.

semantics: State controller using shared nonzero gate curve 000122d2. On the calibration-read branch it interpolates the curve by uint16[ffff11f0] over axis 00014d2a and writes ffff2522. Later code tests only ffff2522!=0 before admitting a calculation involving ffff22e4 and ffff1196.
note: The interpolated magnitude is discarded; only zero versus nonzero affects the state path. The physical purpose of the gate and its coordinate is unresolved.

semantics: State controller using shared nonzero gate curve 000122d2. When its read gates pass, it interpolates the curve by uint16[ffff11b8] over axis 00014d2a and writes ffff2524. A retained-value branch and the following transition logic test only whether ffff2524 is zero.
note: The interpolated magnitude is not consumed. The physical state, coordinate, and timing represented by the gate are unresolved.

semantics: RPM-curve torque-correction builder. It looks up uint16 map 00014c1a, forms a nonnegative byte difference selected by ffff4181.bit7, multiplies the lookup by that difference, divides by 256, and writes ffff14e2.
note: The live lookup result is consumed inline after its scratch copy to ffff14e4. FUN 00065cd8 and FUN 00064a1c consume ffff14e2 in the same signed torque-state component as Engine Torque Map 00010b8e. The physical x*0.1 Nm scale remains a catalog candidate.

semantics: Engine Torque Map accessor. It copies the 16-word column axis at ROM 0002378c to a stack buffer, calculates q=min(65535,floor(u16[ffff1024]*40960/ROM16[00009534])), performs a 16x16 uint16 lookup of 00010b8e by ffff11b6 and q, and writes signed lookup-32768 to ffff18ca.
note: The accessor census records the second axis as ROM 0002378c with operand kind copy because r6 points to its byte-identical runtime stack copy. With the catalog Cylinder Filling scale x*160/65536, the exact q formula becomes 100*BFS/scaler. The VQ35HR JK00D homolog FUN 00067be8 has the same 126-byte structure and uses corresponding map 00012922, row axis 00016f3c, column axis 00023884, and scaler 000095f6.

semantics: P0128 thermostat-function monitor dispatcher. It invokes FUN 000b6b5a every tenth pass, then reports DTC descriptor 0xcb on either of two completion conditions.
note: The exact descriptor 203 record at 00019ce4 contains DTC P0128. The two completion conditions and their status-bit updates are code-proven; their physical trip interpretation is not assigned here.

semantics: Periodic P0128 thermostat-model coordinator. It calls surface-product accessor 000b7b98 unconditionally, forms T=sat_u32(ffff3220+sat_u32(ffff3228+ffff2f98)), writes (u32[ffff2d04]>>1)-(T>>1) to ffff33fc, scales that signed balance through 000b7c84 into ffff3400, and combines the result with ffff3348 under signed saturation into ffff2d28.
note: Unsigned additions saturate at 0xffffffff. The final addition saturates to int32. The broader state machine and the physical units of its model terms remain unresolved.

semantics: P0128 balance-surface product accessor. It looks up uint16 map 0000d40e by current RPM/12.5 and Base Fuel Schedule. A nonzero aggregate inhibit mask ffff22e0 forces zero; otherwise the lookup is multiplied by a caller-supplied uint8 coefficient and written as uint32 ffff2d04.
note: Caller 000b6b5a supplies ffff1024, ffff22e0, ffff11bc, and the maximum of two selected byte coefficients. Every map and axis cell is zero in stock JK03A and JK08A.

semantics: Signed P0128 balance scaler. It clamps input d to -107350..107350, sets K=min(uint8[00008542]*uint8[00008543],10735), and writes clamp(trunc0(20000*d/K),-200000,200000) to ffff3400. K=0 selects the corresponding signed saturation endpoint without division.
note: Stock K is 20*8=160, so the unsaturated stock gain is 125. The input arrives in r4 from ffff33fc; the function has no direct RAM read of that staging word.

semantics: P0128 temperature-difference coefficient accessor. It looks up uint16 L from curve 00014b0a by the raw output of upstream curve 00015c40, derives d=clamp(trunc0(ffff3348/10000)-100*uint8[ffff2733]+5000,0,32767), and writes floor(d*floor(L*ROM8[00008543]/256)/256) to ffff2d08.
note: The raw-50 conversion of exact DID 0x1106 makes the clamped factor a model-temperature-minus-IAT difference in 0.01 deg C units. Every cell of 00014b0a and 00015c40 and every point of axis 00013ff4 is zero, so ffff2d08 is always zero in stock JK03A and JK08A.

semantics: P0128 inverse-weight term accessor. It derives a model-temperature-minus-IAT difference in 0.02 deg C units, selects a byte coefficient by previous-cycle coarse vehicle speed <=2 or >2 counts, applies inverse map weight 255-min(lookup_u16(00014cca),255), scales by the nonzero 00015bf0-derived parameter, and writes the uint32 result to ffff2f98.
note: Caller 000b6b5a supplies all four inputs and is the sole reader of ffff2f98. Stock maps 00014cca and 00015bf0 and axis 00013b38 are zero; 00015bf0 is replaced with one. Both speed coefficients and both coordinate constants are zero, so the stock result is always zero in JK03A and JK08A.

semantics: P0128 RPM-curve coordinator. It looks up curves 00015bf0, 00015c40, and 00015c80 over shared RPM/12.5 axis 00013ca8; returns the 00015c40 result through a caller output word, conditionally replaces the 00015c80 result with one below a model-temperature threshold, and writes one instead of a zero 00015bf0 result to ffff35a0.
note: Every cell of all three curves and every point of their shared axis is zero in JK03A and JK08A. The 00015bf0 path therefore writes one to ffff35a0; the physical meanings of the three curve outputs remain unresolved.

semantics: Fuel-level signal conditioner and EVAP coordinate publisher. It scales ten-bit meter CAN field ffff3e24 by 39680/1024, maintains held and low-pass words, gates the live coordinate by diagnostic result-state indices 0x14a, 0x45/P0461, 0x46/P0460, and -1, evaluates 00014bca, and writes ffff282e for the periodic snapshot to ffff272a.
note: All 16 map cells are 0xffff. The output remains live through ffff272a, which has seven reads in four EVAP functions.

semantics: Meter CAN payload decoder used by the fuel-level monitor. It assembles ffff3e24 from payload byte 1 and the top two bits of byte 2, assembles a second ten-bit field at ffff3e2e from payload byte 6 and the top two bits of byte 7, and sets validity bit 7 at ffff4225.
note: Dispatcher FUN 000c3b14 invokes this handler for encoded identifier 0x5000. The homologous factory M&A-to-ECM CAN path and P0460/P0461-gated consumer establish the fuel-level context for ffff3e24.

semantics: ATU-II prescaler initialization. It writes 1 to PSCR1 at fffff404 and to the other prescaler registers, then configures associated control bytes.
note: Together with TCR3 = 5 and TCR8 = 0x55 in 0002718a this gives timer channel 3 and the channel-8 one-shot down-counters an input of Pphi/64 according to the SH7059 hardware manual.

semantics: Per-channel injector-event handler. It writes current one-hot event mask ffff1936, removes that bit from DFCO fallback history ffff1935, and, while active rotating count ffff1937 and aggregate mask ffff22e0 are nonzero, decrements the count and adds the current bit back to history before invoking masked one-shot scheduler 0002c13c. It refills scheduled-duration array ffff224e through FUN 00054d3e before that call.
note: The path proves that the DFCO rotating-release tail advances on injector events. Physical channel-to-cylinder order remains unresolved.

semantics: DFCO entry-delay selector. It returns stage1<<8|stage2 for 000503e0. Stock ROM8[0000870c].bit7 clear branches select stage 1 values 40, 60, or 75 and stage 2 zero; a configuration override can place 10 or 20 in stage 2. Conditional non-stock branch interpolates 000120f6 into stage 1 from a speed-derived coordinate.
note: All cells of 000120f6 are 60. Delay units are the periodic DFCO scheduler count.

semantics: DFCO exit-delay selector. It returns zero under master/runtime gates, including ffff2458.bit5 set with scheduled RPM-drop class ffff106a at least 4; otherwise restore classes 1, 2, and 3 select calibrated bytes at 00008c4b, 00008c41 or 00008c40, and 00008c4d or 00008c4c according to stock selector ROM8[0000870c].bit7.
note: All relevant stock delay bytes are zero, so normal state-4 exit delay is zero.

semantics: Rotate a six-channel one-hot mask left with wrap from bit 5 to bit 0. State machine 000503e0 applies it repeatedly to build the injector-event release-tail mask.
note: The loop in 000503e0 limits the generated mask to six channels.

semantics: Count-to-six-channel inhibit-mask accessor. It takes max(ffff22fd,ffff2ece), clamps the unsigned count to 0..6, and for nonzero counts selects table 00011a6b values 01, 05, 15, 17, 1f, or 3f.
note: The physical producer meanings of both counts remain unresolved.

semantics: P2119/P1238 ETC-actuator-fault six-channel inhibit-mask coordinator. Runtime-record byte1.bit7 at exact indices 0x71 and 0x123 enables 000509a0, which maps RPM/25 43..48 to masks 01,05,07,0f,1f,3f; 000509ea can add 3f at coarse speed <=2 under ffff10e4.bit2.
note: Exact JK08A descriptor index 113 is P2119 ETC ACTR-B1 and index 291 is P1238 ETC ACTR-B2. The mask is ORed after Power Balance and cannot be cleared by that replacement.

semantics: Power Balance mask updater. When service-0x30 IOLID-0x0c active flag ffff99c5.bit3 is set it copies value byte ffff992f to ffff2b2c and sets ffff41fb.bit6; otherwise it clears that active bit.
note: A structured Nissan-family profile identifies IOLID 0x0c as Power Balance and maps bits 1..32 to cylinders 1..6. The VQ35HR factory ESM independently defines the test as cutting one injector signal at a time.

semantics: Apply the Power Balance replacement. It returns the aggregate input while ffff41fb.bit6 is clear and returns cached service value ffff2b2c while that bit is set.
note: The replacement occurs after the global, DFCO, and count masks have been ORed.

semantics: Merge three mask inputs with bitwise OR and return only the low six bits.
note: The result is the final value written to ffff22e0.

semantics: Update upstream DFCO mode or eligibility bit ffff2459.bit5. One gate requires ffff2451.bit7 or ffff24cd.bit7 together with 0008c3fa. The alternate gate selects inverted ffff417f.bit3 or ffff4230.bit7 according to ffff4245.bit0, ffff4249.bit4, and ffff259c. The same function derives ffff417f.bit3 and maintains ffff4230.bit7 through a small hysteresis state.
note: Whole-program p-code establishes this as the only writer of bit 5. Physical signal identities remain unresolved.

semantics: Auxiliary upstream DFCO gate. It requires ffff4184.bit6 clear and ffff244f.bit5 set. It normally returns true; one exception returns false when ffff41a5.bit2 is set, ffff41bd.bit0 is clear, and both ffff34e4 and ffff34e6 are below 20.
note: Boolean behavior is exact; physical signal names are unresolved.

semantics: Current-pass common and two-bank injection-precursor producer. It selects BFS ffff1024 or alternate ffff123e, optionally bounds it by RPM-derived limit and ffff34f6, scales it by ffff22e6 over 131072, applies bank multipliers ffff40b6/ffff40b8 over 0x6400, adds signed transient word ffff2300, scales through 0002657c by common Q14 gain ffff165e, clamps to uint16, and lower-bounds all results at ROM16[0x94e8]=170. It writes bank words ffff18c0/ffff18c2 and common word ffff1876.
note: Scheduler index 42 follows multiplier publication, common-gain calculation, and transient coordinator in the same periodic pass. Physical meanings of the bank multiplier and common gain remain unresolved.

semantics: Maximum/scalar consumer of the transformed six-channel pulse array. It takes max(ffff23d4..ffff23de, ffff241c), combines it with a speed-derived factor and existing bounds, and writes scalar bytes ffff23bf and ffff23f0.
note: Scheduler copier 00020dfe snapshots the same array to ffff2348, from which FUN 00054d3e fills the ATU-II duration array. This function applies ffff241c as the same lower bound that FUN 00054d3e applies through snapshot ffff2390. The physical meanings of the derived bytes remain unresolved.

semantics: Signed transient additive-term producer. It writes clamp_s16(trunc_toward_zero(uint8(ffff150a)*int16(ffff1a66)/256)) to ffff2300; a runtime gate involving ffff245d can force zero.
note: The exact signed rounding and saturation are code-proven. The physical transient qualifier remains unresolved.

semantics: Saturated fuel-base accumulator. It writes ffff231a=clamp_u16(int32(ffff15f8)+0x4000+uint16(ffff230c)+uint16(ffff15da)).
note: Coordinator 00057608 calls this before 000554f8 and final publisher 000556ec. Physical units remain unresolved.

semantics: Fuel-multiplier target, limiter, and publisher. It starts with sum=min(65535,ffff231a+ffff240a) and target=floor(sum*ffff22e8/16384), then applies mode gates, bounds, and rate limits into working word ffff18e4. If aggregate inhibit mask ffff22e0 equals 0x3f it publishes zero to ffff22e6; otherwise it publishes ffff18e4.
note: The exact full-inhibit publication rule directly suppresses the multiplier consumed later by 0004e974. Other physical mode names remain unresolved.

semantics: Fuel-multiplier calculation coordinator at periodic table index 35. Its fixed call order is 00054eb8, 0005594a, conditional 00055596, 0005525a, 00055098, 00052f00, 00054ee0, 000554ae, 00055648, 000554f8, and 000556ec. The call to 00055596 is gated on ROM8[00008b42] bit 0 or ROM8[00008b34] bit 4; stock holds both clear, so 0005594a is the only commanded-mixture writer in the stock image.
note: Table order places this coordinator after final mask producer 0004ed88 and before common gain 00053698, transient coordinator 000522c4, precursor 0004e974, and six-channel builder 0004ecac.

semantics: Pure saturating affine-floor transform applied to each injection-pulse word. With stock words C0=13656, C1=16384, D0=4250, and D1=0 at 0x91da, it returns max(x, sat_u16(floor((x*C0+100*D0)/16384)), sat_u16(floor((x*C1+100*D1)/16384))). FUN 0004eba2 applies it between ffff23c8 and ffff23d4, and FUN 00051a98 between ffff155c and ffff1568.
note: The stock second affine branch equals x, so the result simplifies to max(x, sat_u16(floor((13656*x+425000)/16384))). It is the last minimum-pulse floor before the hardware: on the 10 us duration scale it holds a 0.26 ms minimum and stops acting at 1.56 ms.

semantics: First event-interval snapshot. Under its gates it calculates a wrap-corrected unsigned difference between current timestamp ffff185c and previous timestamp ffff84cc, writes the difference shifted right by five to ffff11fc, and updates ffff84cc. A fault gate writes 0xffffffff instead.
note: The shift and wrap arithmetic are exact. The physical timer frequency and event-to-crank-angle conversion remain hardware-level unknowns.

semantics: Second event-interval snapshot. Under its gates it calculates a wrap-corrected unsigned difference between current timestamp ffff185c and previous timestamp ffff84d0, writes the difference shifted right by five to ffff22d4, and updates ffff84d0. A fault gate writes 0xffffffff instead.
note: The shift and wrap arithmetic are exact. The physical timer frequency and event-to-crank-angle conversion remain hardware-level unknowns.

semantics: Unsigned byte division by ten used by APC command schedulers. It multiplies the input by reciprocal 0x199a, stores floor(input/10) through the word pointer, and stores input-10*quotient through the byte pointer.
contract: Given r4=x in 0..255, r5=&q and r6=&r, writes q=floor(x/10) as uint16 and r=x-10*q as uint8.
note: The reciprocal is exact over the admitted byte domain.

semantics: Primary APC compare scheduler. It zero-extends the command byte, splits it through 00028e7c, and on the normal ffff24c9.bit6-clear path carries complete decades through 00028dc8 and 0002ab24. It calculates ffff16c2=min(65535,floor(ffff22bc*remainder/10)) and writes GR11A fffff5c2 as ffff158a+ffff16c2 or the TCNT11+3 fallback.
note: The bit6-set fallback branch clamps only inputs above 199. Targets 110..117 avoid that clamp but must not override the stock command in fallback mode because its physical angle contract is unresolved.

semantics: Secondary APC compare scheduler. On the normal ffff24c9.bit6-clear path it splits the full primary-plus-offset command through 00028e7c, carries complete decades, calculates ffff16c2=min(65535,floor(ffff22bc*remainder/10)), and writes GR11B fffff5c4 as ffff158a+ffff16c2 or the TCNT11+2 fallback.
note: The bit6-set position-diagnostic fallback uses a separate threshold-120 path. The SH7058 manual proves the GR11B output-low action; board polarity and the physical spark edge remain unverified.

semantics: Engine-event capture and interval updater. It derives a wrap-corrected interval from timer captures, publishes the interval to ffff22d4 and ffff11fc, divides it by 12 through exact unsigned divider 00021ce0, and writes the quotient to ffff22bc and ffff22ba. Later event branches use the same normalized interval for APC compare scheduling. The reference capture is GR1E (fffff44c) when called from 0002a51e with r7 = 0 and GR1F (fffff44e) from 0002a5cc with r7 = -1; it stores the capture word in ffff158a at 0002b7cc, forms the event timestamp from TCNT0 and the TCNT1A-to-capture difference, and divides the wrap-corrected difference to the previous event by 32.
note: The captures count phi'/32 = 3.2 us (TCR1A = 5 in 0002718a, PSCR1 = 1 in 000274ac), and FUN 00038272 binds the interval to engine speed as ffff1196 = 32000000 / ffff11fc, so the interval is 120 crank degrees and ffff22bc is 10 degrees.

semantics: Bounded signed mode-state source. With ffff41b9.bit0 clear, ffff424c.bit4 selects ffff99dc, ffff424c.bit5 selects a piecewise step from ffff10da (0 below 0x20, 4-2*(ffff10da>>5) up to 0xbf, -8 above), and otherwise nonvolatile offset ffff29c6 when it lies within the bounds and zero when it does not; ffff41b9.bit0 set forces zero. Signed ROM bounds ROM8[0x821d]=-5 and ROM8[0x821c]=0 clamp the result before it is written to ffff56b2.
note: Scheduler 00020dfe copies the enclosing source block at ffff56b2 to snapshot ffff564c, which 0004dbe8 adds to the timing sum with coefficient 1 in crank degrees while ffff5b31 bits 1..5 are clear. The physical mode semantics of ffff424c remain unresolved.

semantics: Active/reference timing-state field extractor. It writes ffff12de=ffff160f&0x7f and ffff12e0=ffff1610&0x7f. When ROM8[0x8b3f].bit1 is set it writes ffff12df=max(ffff12e0-ffff12de,0), otherwise zero. It also writes ffff23bd=max(ffff12de-ffff11af,0).
note: ffff23bd carries the active cold/hot map state into the normal timing-state compositor branch.

semantics: Timing-state latch. It copies ffff1830 to ffff2404 when ffff1239 is 1 or 2, or when ffff4184.bit6 and ffff2458.bit5 are both clear; otherwise it copies ffff1831.
note: The normal selected-map path uses ffff1830. Scheduler 00020dfe snapshots ffff2404 into ffff2378 for the engine-event correction builder 0004d99c; both alternatives are crank degrees of the final coordinate.

semantics: Periodic timing coordinator. Its relevant fixed order is 0004aad0, 0004af38, 0004ba48, 0004bbac, 0004d2a6, 0004afdc, 0004bdc2, 0004bf6c, 0004c02e, 0004c136, then 0004c1e4.
note: This function is periodic table index 70. Map selection 0004e1c0, knock coordinator 000493e8, and transition coordinator 00065434 precede it at indices 63, 64, and 65.

semantics: Secondary APC command builder. It computes byte offset=120-u8(ffff237a); when ffff24c9.bit5 is set it also subtracts ROM8[0x8649] and lower-clamps at zero. Stock ROM8[0x8649]=0 and ffff237a is bounded to 0..114, so the stock offset is 6..120. It writes ffff2230, adds the offset to ffff2022, and tail-calls 0002acba.
note: For a newly applied primary target at most 117 the sum is at most 237, so the override introduces no uint8 wrap before the GR11B scheduler. Physical pulse polarity remains a hardware boundary.

semantics: Engine-event timing dispatch. Its exact call order is 0004e112, 0004e0c2, 0004d99c, 0004dbe8, 0004df82, then 0004e080.
note: The dispatcher is engine-event task table index 4 and establishes the ordered path from correction state to both APC compare registers.

semantics: Periodic transition-state coordinator. Its fixed tail calls nonlinear controller 00063f30 on both final branches.
note: This function is periodic table index 65, after map selection at index 63 and knock coordination at index 64 and before timing compositor 0004d888 at index 70.

semantics: Transient threshold builder. It uses x=clamp_u8(16*u8(ffff1a58)-2704) to look up 0x11f6a into ffff1394. With c=clamp(u8(ffff479e),55,85)-50 it writes ffff1393=min(255,floor(2*(ffff1394*c+25)/25)), then updates a separate mode bit.
note: Code establishes a scaled state threshold. Catalog matches place 0x11f6a in the Initial Retard Quantity family but do not identify which transient mode or prove that ffff1393 is an applied retard amount.

semantics: Transient hysteresis-state updater. It compares max(u16(ffff10a6)-0x8000,0) with threshold 32*ffff1393 and hysteresis 32*ROM8[0x8383], uses comparator 000259d0, and maintains ffff2478 bit 6. Subsequent branches in the same function use that bit while updating ffff2474.
note: No direct path from bit 6 to ffff11d4 or an APC compare is established. The table has an operational threshold role without an assigned direct retard quantity.

semantics: Periodic-table index-11 request-limit source coordinator. Its ordered calls reach rotational-speed request limiter 0007584e through candidate dispatcher 00075e9e before the later index-18 signed-minimum arbitration.
note: This establishes current-pass production of 0000942c-derived ffff19d8 before FUN 00071508.

semantics: Request-limiter candidate dispatcher reached by periodic source coordinator 000769c0. It invokes rotational-speed request limiter 0007584e, which publishes candidate ffff19d8.
note: The dispatcher belongs to the signed request path and does not enter fuel mask ffff22e0.

semantics: Periodic-table index-20 request-controller coordinator. Its fixed relevant order is 000702c6, 0007038a, 000703b2, 0007054a, 00070670, 00070812, 00070cd6, 00070d20, then final selector 00070d82.
note: The final selector publishes ffff2438 and ffff19c2 before the index-21 request boundary.

semantics: Periodic-table index-21 request-boundary coordinator. It calls 000797d0 and then signed boundary stage 00079030, which publishes shared request coordinate ffff19c6 before index-22 consumers.
note: This is the scheduling bridge from the selected signed limit to downstream inverse-coordinate calculations.

semantics: Unsigned byte below-threshold hysteresis comparator used by the vehicle-speed fuel-cut RPM gate.
contract: Given uint8 value r4, threshold r5, hysteresis r6, and previous Boolean r7, returns uint8((r4 - (r7 ? r6 : 0)) < r5).
note: FUN 0004f050 uses threshold 180 and hysteresis 20 in RPM/25 units, so its state sets below 4500 RPM and clears at or above 5000 RPM.

semantics: Diagnostic runtime-record byte-1 bit-7 predicate. It addresses ffff5718 + 3*index and returns that bit as a Boolean.
contract: Input r4 is interpreted as a signed 16-bit record index. Index -1 returns zero without reading RAM; other indices return byte1.bit7 of the selected three-byte record.
note: Indices 0x71 and 0x123 are exact P2119 and P1238 descriptors in 0005096c.

semantics: Nissan diagnostic service 0x30 Output Control handler. IOLID 0x0c stores its value byte in ffff992f and controls active flag ffff99c5.bit3.
note: The factory ESM identifies this operation as Power Balance, which cuts one injector signal at a time.

semantics: Vehicle-speed fuel-cut RPM gate updater. It sets ffff24a7.bit5 below 4500 RPM and clears it at or above 5000 RPM after the state has set.
note: The gate is evaluated before the 93/91 speed hysteresis in 0004f19c.

semantics: Zero-speed high-BFS/high-RPM fuel-inhibit contributor. At standstill it returns true when RPM is at least 4800, the high byte of Base Fuel Schedule is at least 0x48, and timer ffff253b has expired.
note: A failed condition reloads the timer with 110 counts; its wall-clock duration depends on the unresolved task timebase.

semantics: Vehicle-speed fuel-cut contributor. With RPM gate ffff24a7.bit5 clear, it enters at coarse speed 93 and remains active until speed falls below 91; stock activation delay is zero.
note: The candidate speed conversion is approximately 186/182 km/h and requires hardware validation.

semantics: P1217 engine-overtemperature fuel-inhibit contributor. It qualifies raw coolant at 190 with retention through 180, then applies a 1900/1700 RPM hysteresis under diagnostic phase and mode gates.
note: The exact homologous coolant conversion raw-50 gives candidate thresholds 140/130 degrees C; P1217 is exact for JK08A.

semantics: Dual-bank MAF fault RPM inhibit contributor. It returns true while the snapshotted OR of P0101/P0102/P0103 and P010B/P010C/P010D runtime-record byte1.bit7 is set and RPM is at least 2400.
note: Extension record 0x129 is a live six-DTC group summary produced after diagnostic runtime-record initialization; it is not a seventh ROM descriptor.

semantics: Side-effect-only low-speed RPM exposure accumulator. Eligible operation at coarse speed <=4 and 2300..2900 RPM adds 12 toward cap 24000; the principal decay path subtracts one.
note: Its return is discarded. The accumulated state is consumed by 0004f958.

semantics: Low-speed sustained-RPM fuel-inhibit contributor. Accumulator ffff1932 reaching 24000 arms ffff247c.bit7 at or above 1800 RPM; the state remains active through 1500 RPM and clears below it.
note: FUN 0004f7e0 is the exact accumulator producer.

semantics: Transition-window low-speed RPM inhibit contributor. It requires low speed, RPM at least 2700, coolant raw at least 0x55, and a transition counter below 60; it clears below 2200 RPM or when the counter reaches 150.
note: Current ffff244f.bit2 and previous ffff2453.bit2 control the transition counter.

semantics: Direct shared-status fuel-inhibit contributor. It returns ffff418c.bit1.
note: Primary startup and both recovery clear paths zero the byte. A whole-program exact and computed-address census plus the recovered DMAC configuration find no path that can set bit 1, so the contributor is stock-inert in the proven application lifecycle.

semantics: Status-gated engine-running fuel-inhibit contributor. With ffff2499.bit1 and ffff2494.bit4 set and ffff244f.bit2 clear, it returns active whenever RPM is nonzero.
note: All 16 stock calibration bytes at 000126f4 are zero. Startup and both recovery paths clear ffff2494; every runtime writer preserves bit 4, so the prerequisite and contributor remain inactive in the proven stock lifecycle.

semantics: Composite status/RPM fuel-inhibit contributor. It combines stock-inert lifecycle-zero status ffff41ea.bit7, an 1800/1600 RPM state gated by ffff245d.bit6 and ffff2458.bit5, and a high-RPM state selected by ffff24ce.bit2 or ffff24d2.bit0.
note: Normal startup and both recovery paths clear ffff41ea. A 2315-function p-code census finds only runtime writers 0007c166, 00050920, and 0007f870, all of which preserve bit 7; the recovered DMAC does not overlap the byte. Stock map 00012a32 is all 0xff, producing a 6375 RPM high boundary with 200 RPM hysteresis. Two calls with index -1 are inert.

semantics: Critical ECM/ETC fault RPM inhibit contributor. With qualification counter ffff4b0e greater than four and the P0603/P0605/P2119/P1238 aggregate in ffff41ea.bit5 set, it activates at 2525 RPM and retains through 2000 RPM.
note: FUN 0007d856 produces the qualification counter from the aggregate plus engine-running, temperature-difference, and coolant-warm latches.

semantics: ETC-fault staged six-channel RPM mask. RPM/25 values below 43 return 00; values 43..48 return 01,05,07,0f,1f,3f respectively; values above 48 retain 3f.
note: The non-linear bit sequence is exact and is not interpreted as physical injector order.

semantics: ETC-fault low-speed full-mask helper. It returns 3f when coarse speed is <=2 and ffff10e4.bit2 is set, otherwise zero.
note: This mask is ORed with the staged RPM mask.

semantics: CAN-derived RPM-ceiling fuel-inhibit contributor. A valid source byte defines max(36,source)*50 RPM; the contributor activates strictly above that threshold and releases with 300 RPM hysteresis.
note: Source values 0 and 0xff and fault bits ffff4189.bit1 or ffff4250.bit7 disable the limiter. Internal dispatch key 0x2ee0 is not asserted to be a physical CAN identifier.

semantics: P0011/P0021 intake-valve-timing fault RPM inhibit contributor. After qualification and a ten-count fault phase it activates at 3000 RPM and retains through 2800 RPM.
note: Exact DTC descriptor indices 208 and 209 are P0011 and P0021. U1001, U1000, and U1010 predicates are prerequisites rather than output DTCs.

semantics: Critical-diagnostic qualification counter updater. A clear ffff41ea.bit5 resets ffff4b0e. While that aggregate bit is set, ffff422e.bit7 plus ffff422f.bits4/5 permit saturating increment; loss of any of those three latches holds the prior count rather than resetting it.
note: The consumer requires the count to exceed stock threshold four.

semantics: Critical ECM/ETC diagnostic aggregate updater. It recomputes ffff41ea.bit5 as the OR of predicate 0007c3b4 over exact runtime indices 0x4e, 0x51, 0x6f, 0x121, 0x70, 0x122, 0x72, 0x73, 0x77, and 0x79.
note: The records are exact P0603/P0605 ECM and P2119/P1238 ETC-actuator descriptors. A 2315-function p-code census found no unresolved ffff41ea writer; every runtime writer preserves bit 7.

semantics: Diagnostic status state-machine updater. Its ffff41ea writes modify only bits 1 through 4; read-modify-write operations and whole-byte stores preserve bits 5 through 7.
note: The physical identities of the managed status phases remain unresolved. Preservation of ffff41ea.bit7 is code-proven.

semantics: Critical diagnostic-record predicate with minus-one sentinel support.
contract: Given signed record index n, return 1 iff n is not -1, runtime[n].byte1.bit7 is set, and either runtime[n].byte1.bit5 or descriptor_attribute[n].bit13 is set; otherwise return 0.
note: The descriptor-attribute pointer table begins at 0001a14c.

semantics: Diagnostic runtime-record initializer. Its first loop covers 0x157 three-byte records from ffff5718, clears extension record 0x129, and preserves only the explicit higher-index exception set.
note: Record 0x129 is the first extension record after the exact ROM descriptor range and is not in the preserved exception set.

semantics: Diagnostic readiness-latch updater. It sets ffff422e.bit7 after RPM reaches 400, sets ffff422f.bit4 after raw coolant exceeds selected raw temperature by at least 20, and sets ffff422f.bit5 at raw coolant 0x78 or above.
note: The three target bits are set-only in this updater and are cleared by diagnostic reset service 00080b54. Raw coolant 0x78 corresponds to 70 deg C under the homologous raw-50 conversion. Selected raw temperature becomes a zero sentinel after the computed START SIGNAL and low-voltage transition, so bit 4 is a transition qualifier rather than a comparison with a second physical temperature.

semantics: Diagnostic state reset service. Among its record and state clears it clears ffff422e.bit7 and ffff422f.bits4/5, resetting the three readiness latches used by 0007d856.
note: Other masks in the same service clear independent diagnostic state bits.

semantics: Diagnostic group-summary updater. Its first group starts byte1 and byte2 accumulators at zero, ORs those bytes across runtime indices 0xba, 0x07, 0xbb, 0x08, 0xbc, and 0x09, and writes the two accumulated status bytes to extension record 0x129 at ffff5a94 and ffff5a95.
note: The six exact descriptors are P0101/P0102/P0103 for bank 1 and P010B/P010C/P010D for bank 2. The function builds additional diagnostic group summaries outside this annotation; byte 0 of extension record 0x129 is not consumed by the fuel path.

semantics: CAN 0x177 payload decoder selected by internal key 0x2ee0. It copies payload byte 0 into live RPM-ceiling source ffff2818 and writes payload byte 2 bits 0..2 into live TCM gear-phase index ffff1066 for periodic snapshotting to ffff1064.
note: The stock mailbox record encodes standard ID 0x177 as STDID shifted left by five. Passive target traffic correlates the low three bits of byte 2 with zero-based gear progression and shift phase.

semantics: Invalid-message fallback for the internal-key-0x2ee0 source. It writes 0xfe to ffff2818.
note: The consumer treats 0xfe as a valid neutral 12700 RPM ceiling rather than its explicit 0 or 0xff invalid values.

semantics: APC command-phase normalizer. It adjusts the stored command decade and remainder in mode-dependent 10- and 20-count steps selected by ffff13b2, preserving the scheduler representation across engine-position events.
note: Primary scheduler 0002a892 calls this after programming the current GR11A compare. The event-position interpretation is exact; physical crank-angle units remain unverified.

semantics: Normal-mode APC set-compare continuation. It consumes the stored command decade and remainder across later position events, calculates the next fractional offset from ffff22bc, writes GR11A, and enables the current-cylinder low-byte POPCR action.
note: Together with 00028dc8 this proves that command decades are scheduled rather than discarded. External ignition-driver polarity and the physical spark edge remain unverified.

semantics: Crank/cam position-diagnostic APC fallback-mode updater. It evaluates runtime records 0x47/0x48 for P0340, 0x8a/0x8b for P0345, and 0x4a/0x4b for P0335. The P0335-only combination can set ffff24cf.bit6; periodic dispatcher 00020dfe snapshots that bit to ffff24c9.bit6 for both APC schedulers.
note: The exact JK08A descriptors map those six runtime indices to the stated DTCs. Bit6 selects alternate scheduler behavior and is a mandatory stock-pass-through gate for a late retard override.

semantics: Main-loop coordinator for the every-tenth-interrupt scheduler. It enables interrupts before waiting for ffff84b9 bit 2, calls FUN 00020dfe indirectly through literal 00028090, and then reaches FUN 00027aa2 before the next loop iteration. FUN 00020dfe returns with interrupts masked, making the point immediately after the indirect call a coherent but interrupt-disabled capture boundary.
note: A wrapper substituted through literal 00028090 must call the displaced stock function first and must preserve the interrupt state expected by the main loop. Any additional copy extends an existing interrupt-disabled interval.

semantics: HCAN1 mailbox initializer. It reads 30 four-byte records at 0000975a, maps record index i to physical mailbox i+1, decodes bytes as firmware type, DLC, and big-endian STDID<<5, and programs the mailbox control fields. Types 1/2 configure MBC 010 receive, types 3/4 configure MBC 000 transmit, and type 5 configures MBC 111 inactive. Types 2 and 4 additionally clear the corresponding MBIMR bit to enable mailbox activity interrupts.
note: Record 25 at 000097be configures physical mailbox 26 as stock-inactive. Mailbox 0 and mailbox 31 are initialized separately. The table describes configured capability and does not prove traffic observed on a vehicle.

semantics: Stock HCAN1 type-3 transmit submitter for one mailbox-table index. It checks the ten-byte software record at ffff3ab5+10*i, applies the frame-specific phase and condition gates, copies the configured DLC bytes into physical mailbox i+1, and contributes the mailbox bit to the TXPR request aggregate.
note: The caller 000c38de selects only firmware type 3. A custom type-4 mailbox does not share this software-record submission path.

semantics: Periodic stock HCAN1 transmit scanner. When the CAN runtime gate is active it clears the TX request aggregate, scans all 30 mailbox records, invokes 000c3746 only for firmware type 3, and publishes the resulting bits to HCAN1 TXPR0/TXPR1 while interrupts are masked.
note: Periodic table word 00021928 calls this function before serializer coordinator 000c3de4 at 00021930. Type 4 is intentionally excluded.

semantics: Periodic stock HCAN1 payload-serialization coordinator. It maintains the transmit phase counters, scans only firmware type-3 records, invokes the ID-specific serializer, and updates the ten-byte software record and ready state used by the subsequent 000c38de scan.

semantics: Stock HCAN1 SLE1 mailbox-empty interrupt handler. It checks only physical mailbox 28, represented by bit 0x1000 in TXACK1 and ABACK1, clears the acknowledged flag and IRR bit 8, marks ffffa56f, and calls 000c6b68 only after successful transmission. It returns directly with RTE.
note: A custom SLE1 target must preserve the complete mailbox-28 success and abort behavior. Because the stock handler owns RTE, it cannot be called with JSR. An indirect tail jump would consume a general register whose interrupted entry value its prologue must preserve; the implemented telemetry layer uses one combined save/body/restore/RTE handler instead.

semantics: Direct ADC channel reader with optional PF13..PF15 external-mux selection. For channel 0, argument 0 selects mux code 000 before reading ADDR0; argument 0xe000 selects code 111. The caller 0002c4f8 uses those exact combinations for coolant and fuel-temperature acquisition respectively.

semantics: Diagnostic status packer for response bytes ffff3342..ffff3346. For ffff3342, it maps ffff2452.bit7 to bit7, ffff2451.bit3 to bit5, ffff2459.bit7 to bit4, ffff417f.bit2 to bit3, inverse ffff4217.bit1 to bit2, ffff24ae.bit7 to bit1, and ffff2459.bit5 to bit0.
note: The exact service-0x22 table publishes ffff3342 as DID 0x1302 with support mask 0x3f. A structured Nissan profile identifies ffff3342.bit1 as START SIGNAL, binding ffff24ae.bit7 to that diagnostic state.

semantics: Raw battery-ADC hysteresis state updater. It reads phase-2 AN0 mux sample ffff1d6e, enters the upper state at raw 0x33c, returns through the lower threshold 0x308, stores its four-state result at ffff3674, and sets ffff24ad.bit7 for states 2 or 3.

semantics: Accelerator-pedal request preprocessor. It maps snapshot ffff266e to ffff1e6c as 0 below 45, floor((input-45)*1500/125) between 45 and 170, and 1500 at or above 170, then combines bounded offsets and corrections before publishing signed request precursor ffff18f2.
note: ffff1e6c has an exact piecewise APP normalization. ffff18f2 additionally contains other terms and is not a pure pedal percentage.

semantics: Conditional signed pedal-request scaler. When ffff19a2 and ffff23fc are nonzero, it scales ffff18f2 by ROM16[0x944e], divides through both runtime words with x32 staging, clamps to signed 16-bit range, and writes ffff19d4; otherwise it writes zero.
note: The signed arithmetic is exact; its physical requested-torque scale remains unresolved.

semantics: Mode and fault selector for the pedal-request path. It selects ffff19d4 or ffff19ba according to ffff2488.bit7, ROM8[0x8b28], ffff418a.bit2, and ffff24d2.bit7, then writes ffff19d0.
note: The branch contract is exact; the alternate source remains an internal signed request.

semantics: APP request inverse-coordinate publisher. It normalizes signed ffff19d2 with 00075230, inverse-searches current-RPM row of 0xe98e using axis 0x11d0c and coordinate table 0x14114, caps the signed result, and writes APP-derived candidate ffff243c.
note: The inverse-coordinate operation is exact. The QH0/torque names and engineering scales remain candidate semantics.

semantics: Opening-area upper-term builder. It computes sat_u16(ffff122a * ROM16[0x92fc] >> 13) and writes ffff133e, which bounds the 0x1465a plus 0x1469a base in 000476d2.
note: The raw upper-bound role is exact; its physical opening-area scale remains candidate.

semantics: Shared throttle-area compositor. With ffff24d2.bit0 and ffff24ce.bit2 clear, it writes ffff19b2=clamp_u16(ffff183e+ffff1340-(ffff120e>>2)) and ffff19b6=sat_u16(ffff183e+ffff2a1c). The alternate mode converts final channel targets ffff28bc/ffff28be through 0x13202/0x155a0 and sums them into ffff19b2/ffff19b6.
note: The normal request composition and alternate feedback branch are exact. The alternate branch does not establish a normal reverse dependency.

semantics: Throttle-target coordinator. It runs common target-coordinate conversion 0006f464, then invokes per-channel target builder 0006f48c for channels 0 and 1.
note: Channel-to-bank identity remains unverified.

semantics: Common target-opening coordinate builder. It converts ffff19b2/2 through inverse pair 0x155a0/0x13202 and writes ffff3374 without the later monitor division by four.
note: The operational coordinate is exact; the physical degree scale remains candidate.

semantics: Common opening-coordinate monitor. It converts ffff183e/2 through inverse pair 0x155a0/0x13202, divides the uint16 result by four, and writes ffff40c6.
note: This derived monitor is not a per-channel target, TPS measurement, regulator effort, or PWM duty.

semantics: Per-channel throttle-feedback acquisition stage. It executes a six-sample estimator and writes paired internal feedback estimates ffff38a8+2*channel and ffff38e8+2*channel. Its direct-A/D fallback reads channel 7 for code channel 0 and channel 11 for code channel 1.
note: The dual throttle-feedback role is exact. External sensor, bank, and plate identities remain unverified.

semantics: First throttle-feedback normalizer. For each channel it writes clamp_u16(ffff38a8[channel]-64*ffff454e[channel]+0x2000) to ffff2660[channel].
note: Array elements use a two-byte stride.

semantics: Second throttle-feedback normalizer. For each channel it subtracts 64*ffff55b0[channel] from ffff38e8[channel], divides by four with truncation toward zero, adds 0x2000, lower-clamps at zero, and writes ffff2664[channel].
note: The negative add-three correction before the arithmetic shift implements truncation toward zero.

semantics: Per-channel throttle-feedback plausibility selector. It selects between normalized candidates ffff2660/ffff2662 and ffff2664/ffff2666 under DTC-record 0x57 for channel 0, record 0x120 for channel 1, status masks, and calibrated crossover bounds, then writes ffff3884/ffff3886.
note: The code-channel mapping to DTC records is exact; external bank identity is not asserted.

semantics: Per-channel throttle-feedback fault selector. It normally copies ffff3884/ffff3886 to ffff3888/ffff388a and otherwise applies learned or fixed closed-reference fallbacks according to channel status masks.
note: The selected word is the regulator feedback input.

semantics: Per-channel feedback-error encoder. With ffff41a5.bit2 enabled, it compares selected feedback ffff3888/ffff388a with sat_u16(ROM8[0x8cb6]*64+0x2000), writes absolute magnitude ffff36a0/ffff36a4, and writes direction ffff369c/ffff369d.
note: The reference-relative magnitude and direction are exact internal regulator inputs.

semantics: Per-channel target scaler. It writes sat_u16((ffff28bc+2*channel)*16+0x2000) to ffff387a/ffff387c.
note: This is the exact bridge from channel target coordinates into the feedback-regulator domain.

semantics: Per-channel regulator-target selector. The normal no-fault branch selects scaled target ffff387a/ffff387c; fault branches select alternate or fixed references. It writes ffff3926/ffff3928.
note: The selected word is the target input used by 000cb2b6.

semantics: Per-channel target-error encoder. It compares selected target ffff3926/ffff3928 with sat_u16(ROM8[0x8cb6]*64+0x2000), writes absolute magnitude ffff3902/ffff3904, and writes direction ffff3900/ffff3901.
note: The magnitude and direction are exact internal target-reference terms.

semantics: Per-channel target-error scaling stage. It masks the lower four or six magnitude bits according to feedback and status, multiplies the remaining target-reference magnitude by ROM16 literal 0x070a, writes fixed-point magnitude ffff391c/ffff3920, and copies direction to ffff392b/ffff392c.
note: This is the scaled target term consumed by the fixed-point regulator.

semantics: Per-channel throttle-regulator coefficient selector. It updates two hysteresis bits from feedback words, selects normal or fault coefficient sets, and publishes the gain and mode arrays consumed by 000cb614.
note: The coefficient selection is exact; individual physical controller-term names remain unresolved.

semantics: Stateful per-channel throttle regulator. It consumes feedback-reference magnitude and direction ffff36a0/ffff369c, scaled target magnitude and direction ffff391c/ffff392b, and coefficient/state arrays selected by 000cb41c. It publishes effort magnitude ffff37b8+4*channel and direction ffff369a+channel, and writes state ffff2628+4*channel capped by ROM32[0x96bc]=0x000d0000 for the next-pass snapshot.
note: The controller data flow and output/state distinction are exact. A simple PID or physical torque interpretation is not assigned.

semantics: Per-channel throttle-effort-to-duty converter. It reads ffff37b8+4*channel using unsigned offset 0xe0 from base ffff36d8, shifts effort right by six, applies the ffff39b0 supply-compensation divisor derived with ROM16[0x933a], clamps the intermediate command to 500, applies stock literal cap 490, and writes ffff374c+2*channel.
note: The effective address is ffff37b8, not ffff36b8: SH extu.b converts immediate -0x20 to unsigned 0xe0 before the base addition.

semantics: Per-channel throttle-direction publisher. It translates regulator direction ffff369a/ffff369b values -0x10 and 0x0f into channel bits in ffff36dc and ffff385e, with controller-disabled fallback gating.
note: The two masks select which member of each complementary ATU-II PWM pair receives duty. Opening polarity remains unverified.

semantics: Ordered dual-channel throttle-regulator coordinator. For channels 0 and 1 it calls 000cafbc, 000cb078, 000cb140, 000cb1ca, 000cb224, 000cb2b6, 000cb354, 000cb41c, and 000cb614, then calls 000cc5f0 and 000cc6a2 for both channels.
note: The ROM pointer table fixes the exact regulator-stage order.

semantics: Throttle ATU-II PWM publisher. It converts ffff374c/ffff374e to min(320,floor(raw*320/500)), uses direction masks ffff36dc/ffff385e to drive one member and clear the other in each pair, and writes channel 0 to BFR6A/B at fffff510/fffff512 and channel 1 to BFR6C/D at fffff514/fffff516. Disabled output clears all four registers; a fault branch writes fixed 0x40/0x60 values.
note: The MCU register and TO6A-D pin mapping is exact. ECM connector continuity, H-bridge polarity, and channel-to-bank identity require bench validation.

semantics: Transmission request coordinator dispatcher. It always runs four preparation functions, then stock ROM8[0x83c1].bit0 clear admits the transmission block and stock ROM8[0x870c].bit7 clear selects FUN 00077892 instead of alternate FUN 00077dec. It then calls FUN 000789d6 and the common completion function FUN 000777fa.
note: Both selector decisions and the active exact-JK08A implementation are code-proven.

semantics: Common transmission request-bound publisher called after the selected or alternate coordinator. Under stock ROM8[0x83c1].bit0 clear, ffff41a6.bit3 and stock ROM8[0x89c5].bit0 select ffff4162 as the source of ffff3480 and as a signed minimum input for ffff3484. With bit 3 clear, it publishes the ordinary preselected request words. The resulting four words ffff347e, ffff3480, ffff3482, and ffff3484 enter FUN 00079030.
note: FUN 00077892 clears the selecting bit before this call in the recovered stock lifecycle, so its 0x942c-derived ffff4162 candidate remains unselected without external state mutation.

semantics: Stock HCAN1 receive dispatcher. It matches software-table keys encoded as STDID shifted left by five and calls payload handlers, including key 0x2e80 for CAN 0x174 through FUN 000c47ea and key 0x2ee0 for CAN 0x177 through FUN 000c4ace. Invalid-message dispatch separately reaches their fallback handlers.
note: Stock mailbox records 0x9786 and 0x9782 independently encode standard IDs 0x174 and 0x177 with the same shift.

semantics: CAN 0x174 payload decoder selected by internal key 0x2e80. It decodes payload byte 3 high nibble into live zero-based target gear index ffff1087 and low nibble into live zero-based current gear index ffff1086. Each nibble value 1 through 7 is decremented; zero and values above 7 publish zero. Scheduler 00020dfe copies the pair to ffff1082/ffff1083.
note: Passive target transitions 0x44 -> 0x34 -> 0x33 and 0x22 -> 0x32 -> 0x33 establish high-nibble target and low-nibble current ordering for downshifts and upshifts.

semantics: Invalid-message fallback for CAN 0x174. On the invalid-data branch it writes zero to both live gear indices ffff1086 and ffff1087, resets associated decoded fields, and marks the fallback state.
note: Zero is also the decoder fallback for out-of-range nibble values, so consumers cannot distinguish invalid CAN data from decoded gear index zero through these two bytes alone.

semantics: Exhaust-VTC diagnostic coordinator. It compares common exhaust target ffff2327 with bank-specific actual exhaust bytes ffff2324/ffff2325 and routes failures through descriptor indices 0x84..0x87 and 0xd2..0xd3.
note: The exact JK08A descriptor registry maps indices 0x84..0x87 to P1078/P1084 exhaust-timing-sensor records and 0xd2/0xd3 to P0014/P0024 exhaust-VTC-control records. This provides an independent subsystem binding for the three centered bytes.

semantics: Two-bank exhaust-VTC control coordinator. It runs target-surface accessor 000bfdc0 and target conditioner 000bfe88, then executes the selected per-bank calculation, state machine, and bounded-output stages for banks 0 and 1.
note: The exhaust identity rests on exact DID and DTC bindings for the target and feedback bytes, not on coordinator graph structure alone.

semantics: Alternate commanded-mixture writer reached from coordinator 00057608 only when ROM8[00008b42] bit 0 or ROM8[00008b34] bit 4 is set; stock holds both clear (0xe0 and 0x81), so the function is never called. When reached it writes ffff22e8 = clamp(source, 0x1000, 0x6000) where the source is ffff2732 << 7 when ROM8[00008b42] bit 0 is clear, word ffff557e when ROM8[000086f9] bit 1 is clear, and ROM16[000090f0] = 0x4009 otherwise.
note: Dead in stock calibration; a calibration that sets either gate bit substitutes this writer for stage 0005594a.

semantics: Throttle-opening byte producer and first stage of coordinator 00057608: ffff3528 = min(255, uint16 ffff40c6 * 0x505b >> 16).

Interval-derived engine-speed byte producer. It shifts sample history ffff3e34 -> ffff3e35 -> ffff3e36, divides 41666 by interval quotient ffff22bc through signed divider 00021bbc, saturates the quotient to 255 into ffff3e34, and writes the median of the three samples to ffff2804. When diagnostic-mode snapshot ffff24c9 bit 5 is set it writes saturated engine-speed byte ffff11ea to ffff2804 instead.
note: The diagnostic substitute equates the representation with rpm/12.5.

semantics: Exhaust-VTC enable coordinator. It maintains hysteresis flags from scheduler snapshots: ffff24a9 bit 3 (raw coolant ffff1071 above ROM8[00008e03]=106, release offset 3), ffff24a9 bit 6 (ffff1071 at most ROM8[00008e00]=170 through 000259d0, offset 3), ffff24a8 bits 4 and 2 (engine-speed byte ffff11b2 at least ROM8[00008de9]=72 and ROM8[00008dec]=72, both 900 RPM with 700 RPM release through offset 16), ffff24aa bit 5 (vehicle-speed byte ffff110e at least ROM8[00008e0f]=5, offset ROM8[000086de]=1), ffff24aa bit 7 (ffff110e at most ROM8[00008e0d]=48 through 000259d0, offset 1), and ffff246c bit 3 (oil-temperature snapshot ffff2772 at least ROM8[00008dff]=110, offset 3). It writes ffff248b bit 0 at 000bf852 as the electrical enable: battery snapshot ffff1108 above ROM8[00008e0a]=125 and at most ROM8[00008e07]=200, driver status ffff850c bits 5 and 6 clear, predicate 00025e4e zero, ffff244f bit 5 set, and record predicate 00025e20 clear for the P0014/P0024 extension slots 0x14f, 0x150, 0x151, and 0x152 and the P0078/P0084 records 0x43 and 0x44, and, with ROM8[00008616] bit 0 set as in stock JK08A (tst #1 at 000bf80e skips the block while the bit is clear), the P0197/P0198/P0196 records 0xdd, 0xde, and 0xe4 clear. It writes ffff246c bit 2 at 000bf864 as ffff24a9 bits 3 and 6 both set, latches ffff248c bit 6 on the rising edge of that bit against prior-cycle ffff246f while ffff2458 bit 5 is clear, and latches ffff248c bit 7 on the rising edge of ffff246c bit 3. It writes ffff248b bit 2 at 000bf99a as the operating enable: bit 0 set, ffff2458 bit 5 clear, ffff246c bit 2 with ffff248c bit 6 clear or ffff249c bit 6 set, the engine-speed flag (ffff24a8 bit 4 while ffff24aa bit 5 or ffff2468 bit 3 is set, otherwise ffff24a8 bit 2), and ffff41be bit 6, ffff41d1 bit 7, ffff41d0 bit 0, ffff2f64 bits 0 and 1, and ffff14b8 bits 0 and 1 all clear, and, with ROM8[00008616] bit 0 set (test at 000bf974), ffff246c bit 3 set with ffff248c bit 7 clear.

The engine-speed release value follows the offset 16 added to ffff11b2 while the flag is set. The only caller is coordinator 000c21e6 at 000c21f2. ffff850c bits 5 and 6 are the edge-count anomaly flags of 000c22dc and ffff249c bit 6 the active-test request of 0002e466; the writers of the five inhibit bits are not decoded.

semantics: ATU-II IMI4C input-capture handler for the bank-2 exhaust-cam sensor edge, installed at interrupt pointer entry 0x2020c. It clears IMF4C in TSR3 (fffff480) with mask 0x7f7f, reads capture GR4C (fffff4c6), forms the 16-bit difference to crank reference count ffff158a, and stores it as the edge interval word at window offset 0x7f6 (ffff1a82). It maps event selector ffff13b2 to a segment index (values above 7 minus 5, value 7 to 0, lower values plus 5) stored at ffff16f2 and copies normalized interval ffff22bc to ffff224c. While cylinder index ffff11de is 2, 4, or 6 and driver status ffff850c bit 6 is clear, it shifts ffff1203 into ffff1205 and ffff1201 into ffff1203 and writes ffff1201 = 20*segment + floor(20*interval / ffff22bc) through signed divider 00021bbc at 000c2d2c. It then increments saturating byte ffff4073, the bank-2 edge count of the current window judged by 000c22dc, while arm copy ffff4120 bit 1 or ffff4121 bit 1 is set, and returns with rte.
note: The register identities follow the SH7058 hardware manual: TSR3 at fffff480 holds IMF4C in bit 7 and IMF4D in bit 8, and GR4C and GR4D are the channel-4 general registers at fffff4c6 and fffff4c8. The pointer table at 0x20000 leads the manual vector offsets by one longword (IMI3A handler 0002040c sits at 0x201e4). The bank identity follows the consumer chain ffff1201 -> ffff11c9 -> monitor index 1 -> descriptor 0xd3 (P0024); one phase unit is 0.5 crank degrees (ffff22bc is 10 degrees at the 3.2 us capture clock).

semantics: ATU-II IMI4D input-capture handler for the bank-1 exhaust-cam sensor edge, installed at interrupt pointer entry 0x20210; its body continues at 000c2de0. It clears IMF4D in TSR3 (fffff480) with mask 0x7eff, reads capture GR4D (fffff4c8), forms the 16-bit difference to crank reference count ffff158a, stores it as the edge interval word at window offset 0x7f4 (ffff1a80), and branches into 000c2de0 on the segment-index mapping of event selector ffff13b2.
note: Ghidra separates the continuation at 000c2de0 because the three-way segment branch re-enters the body below the entry; the two parts form one handler.

semantics: Continuation body of IMI4D handler 000c2d76. It completes the segment-index mapping (value 7 to 0, lower values plus 5) into ffff16f2, copies normalized interval ffff22bc to ffff224c, and, while cylinder index ffff11de is 1, 3, or 5 and driver status ffff850c bit 5 is clear, shifts ffff1202 into ffff1204 and ffff1200 into ffff1202 and writes ffff1200 = 20*segment + floor(20*interval / ffff22bc) through signed divider 00021bbc at 000c2e60. It then increments saturating byte ffff4072, the bank-1 edge count of the current window judged by 000c22dc, while arm copy ffff4120 bit 0 or ffff4121 bit 0 is set, and returns with rte.
note: The entry has no caller in the export; it is reached only from 000c2d76. One phase unit is 0.5 crank degrees (ffff22bc is 10 degrees at the 3.2 us capture clock).

semantics: Crank and cam sensor fault predicate. It returns 1 when record predicate 00025e20 reports the stored-fault bit for any of runtime indices 0x14, 0x47, 0x48, 0x49, 0x4a, 0x4b, 0x4c, 0x8a, 0x8b, and 0x8c, and 0 otherwise; two leading calls pass index -1, which the predicate rejects without reading RAM. The descriptor records at 0x19360 + 12*index carry P0335 for 0x14 and 0x4a..0x4c, P0340 for 0x47..0x49, and P0345 for 0x8a..0x8c. Exhaust-VTC monitor 0008f168 and enable coordinator 000bf630 require a zero result.
note: The code identities are read from the descriptor run whose base and stride match the record addresses in defs/JK08A.dtc.csv; those codes are not registry rows themselves.

semantics: TCM status decoder. It maps field ffff3a2e (CAN 0x174 byte 4 bits 5..7) to ffff419b: value 3 sets bits 3 and 4, value 5 sets bits 3 and 5, value 6 sets bits 3 and 6, value 7 sets bits 3 and 7, and other values clear bits 3..7. It clears ffff4194.bit0 for field values 0, 3, 5, 6 and 7 and sets it otherwise, and derives ffff4194.bit2 from words ffff3f8c and ffff3f8e.
note: FUN 00079de4 calls it first through pointer 00079e18 and is entry 58 of the 69-entry table at 00021834 that dispatcher 000209d8 drains on ffff84b9 bit 4. Scheduler 00020dfe latches ffff419b into ffff418f, the prerequisite of transition neutralizer ffff4252.bit1 in FUN 00077892.

semantics: VTC active-test driver for service-0x30 Output Control, reached from 0002e66c at 0002e760 and through it from 000ca79e, with gbr = 0000873e. It writes ffff41fa bit 4 at 0002e50a (ffff248b bit 1 and ffff244f bit 1 set, vehicle-speed byte ffff110e at most ROM8[000089f1]=2, raw coolant ffff1071 in ROM8[000089f3]=110..ROM8[000089f2]=170), bit 0 at 0002e522 (IOLID 0x19 active flag ffff99c7 bit 0 together with bit 4) storing ffff1704 = clamp(int8(ffff993c), ROM8[0000873e]=-20..ROM8[0000873f]=20) at 0002e54c, ffff41fb bit 7 at 0002e576 (IOLID 0x1a, ffff99c7 bit 1) storing ffff1705 from ffff993d at 0002e59e, and exhaust request ffff249c bit 6 at 0002e5ec (IOLID 0x1d active flag ffff99c7 bit 4, ffff248b bit 0, ffff244f bit 1, the same speed and coolant window) storing ffff1706 from ffff9940 at 0002e612; it clears the exhaust request at 0002e61c otherwise.
