The exhaust request bypasses the coolant-window term of enable coordinator 000bf630, and 000bfe88 adds ffff1706 to the exhaust target while it is set.

semantics: Engine-speed word producer, reached from 00038260. It divides constant 32000000 (literal 0003837c loaded at 00038280) by event interval ffff11fc through unsigned divider 00021ce0 at 00038282 and stores the quotient in ffff1196 at 0003829c.
note: ffff1196 is RPM*5.12: ffff11e6 = ffff1196 >> 8 is the RPM/50 byte confirmed against the CAN engine speed on the car, which fixes the 3.2 us interval count to 120 crank degrees.

semantics: Exhaust-cam edge-count monitor, called from engine-event driver 00029588 with gbr = ffff850c. On reset request ffff850c bit 7 it clears indicators ffff850d bits 4..7, zeroes window counters ffff408c..ffff408f whose result bit is clear, zeroes edge counts ffff4072 and ffff4073, and clears bit 7 at 000c23f6. While cylinder index ffff11de is 2, 4, or 6 it judges bank-1 count ffff4072 (zeroed otherwise at 000c24aa): a count of one clears ffff850c bit 5 and ffff850d bits 6 and 4; zero with arm ffff4120 bit 0 sets bit 5 and ffff850d bit 6 and increments ffff408c, setting result bit 3 at ROM8[00008e21]=10; two or more with arm ffff4121 bit 0 sets bit 5 and ffff850d bit 4 and increments ffff408e, setting result bit 1 at 10; both arm bits clear clear bit 5 and the indicators. Bank 2 mirrors this while the index is 1, 3, or 5 (ffff4073 zeroed otherwise at 000c28ce) with bit 6, arm bits 1, ffff850d bits 7 and 5, counters ffff408d and ffff408f, and result bits 4 and 2.
note: Bits 5 and 6 of ffff850c inhibit the edge-phase updates in 000c2de0 and 000c2c58, the actual-position update in 000bfc2e, and the electrical enable in 000bf630; the indicators feed the P1078/P1084 judgement of 00090086 and 0009018c.

semantics: Memory and ROM-check task driven by request byte ffff40be from scheduler task 0002e8d2 while pending flag ffff41de bit 0 is set. Request 1 accumulates the ROM sum (ffff3324, ffff31f8), request 2 compares it against ROM32[000096d4], ROM32[000096dc], ROM16[00005ffe], and ROM16[00006efe] and records the result, request 3 sets ffff4251 bit 0 at 000cdd4e (cmp/eq #3 at 000cdd40), and the further codes 5, 6, 0x31, 0x61, 0x81, 0x82, 0x85, and 0x88 select the other memory operations of the task. The task resets the request byte to zero at 000cdb1e, 000cdb7e, 000cdbca, and 000cdd16 and clears the pending flag when a pass completes.
note: ffff4251 bit 0 selects the fixed 60/50 percent exhaust test fractions in 000c2152 instead of the computed duty words; 000cd75c clears the bit on every reset. The request codes arrive through manufacturer diagnostic service 0xa0 (handler 000306f8).

semantics: Exhaust-cam rest-edge learner, called from coordinator 000c21e6 at 000c21fe. While ffff246b bit 4 is set it forms ffff1376 = 128 + clamp(ROM8[0000831d]=88 - ffff11c8, -40..40) at 000bfb4a and ffff1377 from ROM8[0000831e] and ffff11c9 at 000bfb98 with bound ROM8[00008834]=40, setting ffff2495 bit 3 at 000bfb2a when a deviation reaches the bound; while bit 4 is clear it clears that flag at 000bfb9e. It then stores learned edges ffff479b = clamp_u8(ROM8[0000831d] - ffff1376 + 128) at 000bfbf8 and ffff479c at 000bfc1c and sets ffff2475 bit 1 at 000bfc20 when ffff2495 bit 3 is clear (000bfba2), ffff24a8 bits 7 and 4 are set (tst; bt exit at 000bfba8 and 000bfbb0), and either prior-cycle ffff246e bit 4 is set with ffff246b bit 4 clear or ffff246b bit 4 is set with ffff2535 zero.

semantics: ATU-II channel initialization. It zeroes TCNT1A (fffff440) at 000271be and TCNT4 (fffff4c0) at 000272a4 and writes TCR1A (fffff45d) = 5 at 000271ec, TCR1B (fffff45c) = 0 at 000271f0, and TCR4 (fffff4cc) = 5 at 000272c0 (mov #5 at 000271a6), so channels 1A and 4 count phi'/32 in lockstep once 000274ac starts them together with TSTR1 = 0x73. note: With PSCR1 = 1 (phi' = Pphi/2 = 10 MHz) one count is 3.2 us. The lockstep of the two counters makes the difference between a channel-4 cam capture and the channel-1 crank reference ffff158a a time. The same selection gives the six injector one-shots a 3.2 us step.

semantics: Exhaust-VTC position-sensor monitor, path A (no-edge), called from 0008f168 with the bank in r4 and the enable in r5. With the enable set it sets bit b of arm byte ffff4178 (000900d2 under interrupt mask when both arm bytes were clear for the bank, raising reset request ffff850c bit 7 at 000900d8; 000900f4 otherwise); while indicator ffff850d bit 6 + b is clear it reloads timer ffff43be + b with ROM8[00008e23]=100 at 0009016a, and when the indicator is set and the timer (read at 0009010e) has expired it sets judged latch ffff3580 bit b at 0009011c. A clear enable clears the arm bit at 00090168 and reloads the timer at 0009017a, and a set judged latch clears the arm bit at 00090182.
note: The arm bit reaches capture handler 000c2de0 and monitor 000c22dc through scheduler copy ffff4120. The decrement source of the timer is not identified in the export.

semantics: Exhaust-VTC position-sensor monitor, path B (extra-edge), called from 0008f168 with the bank in r4 and the enable in r5. It sets or clears bit b of arm byte ffff4179 at 000901d8, 000901fa, 0009022c, and 00090246 by the rules of 00090086, raises reset request ffff850c bit 7 at 000901de when both arm bytes were clear for the bank, reloads timer ffff43be + b with ROM8[00008e23]=100 while indicator ffff850d bit 4 + b is clear or the enable is clear, and sets judged latch ffff3581 bit b at 00090222 when the indicator is set and the timer has expired.
note: The arm bit reaches capture handler 000c2c58 and monitor 000c22dc through scheduler copy ffff4121.

semantics: Periodic scheduler task (list entry 00021aa0) for memory task 000cd85c. It clears ffff41b3 bit 4 at 0002e8e8 while byte timer ffff25c4 is zero, and while pending flag ffff41de bit 0 is set (tst #1; bt exit at 0002e8f2) it calls 000cd85c at 0002e8f8 with request byte ffff40be.
note: The pending flag is set by service-0xa0 handler 000306f8 at 000309d6 and cleared by the memory task when a pass completes.

semantics: Exhaust duty reset, reached from initialization path 0002e81a and service-0xa0 handler 000306f8. It clears ffff4251 bit 0 at 000cd76e and ffff41de bit 2 at 000cd772, zeroes checksum state ffff30f8, ffff3084, and ffff30b0, and programs both ATU-II channel-7 cycle pairs from ROM8[00008dfc]=33 and ROM8[00008dfd]=20.
note: Clearing ffff4251 bit 0 returns 000c2152 to the computed duty words; service-0xa0 request 3 selects the fixed 60/50 percent test fractions by setting the bit.

semantics: Engine-oil-temperature producer, called from 000bcd44. With ROM8[00008616] bit 0 set (tst #1; bf at 0003eb96; stock 0x01) it reads ADC sample ffff1d5c at 0003ebb4, filters it through 0003a5e0 into ffff1f92 at 0003ebd0 and raw byte ffff117b at 0003ebd6, converts the byte through curve 00012c6e via 000263a0 into ffff1f94 at 0003ec18, and publishes ffff2876 at 0003ecae: 0xff with ffff4182 bit 7 set at 0003eca4 when the raw byte is outside 3..241 or a P0197, P0198, or P0196 record (0xdd, 0xde, 0xe4 through 00025e20 at 0003ec32, 0003ec3e, 0003ec4a) is stored; the converted value directly while ffff4183 bit 7 is set; otherwise a rising value at once (0003ec98) and a falling value as new + 2 only after a drop of two or more counts, with ffff4182 bit 7 cleared at 0003ec58 on the valid path. With the bit clear it publishes zero.
note: DID 0x111f publishes the byte. Curve 00012c6e is byte-identical to shared thermistor table 00012dea, whose code the ECU declares as deg C+50 through J1979 Mode 01 PIDs 0x05 and 0x0F, so deg C = raw-50 follows from code. Sample ffff1d5c is the phase-3 AN0 external-mux result of selector code 010, stored by sampler 000280d8 at 00028290. Periodic table 00021834 of dispatcher 000209d8 lists the function at index 28. The stock configuration bit keeps the sensor path live, so exhaust-VTC gain coordinate ffff2772 follows the oil temperature.

semantics: Base ignition-angle producer. It derives a divider-based angle from ffff17b8, ffff14dc, ffff1630, ROM8[0x884d]=128, ROM8[0x8b6c]=14, and RPM/12.5 word ffff11bc with factor 0x78 and a 5/2 scaling, and writes ffff23f1=r-14 when r<0x8e and 127 otherwise.
note: ffff23f1 is the base term of the normal compositor branch of 0004bdc2 in crank degrees. The physical meaning of the divider inputs remains unresolved.

semantics: Retard-sum producer. It writes ffff23c5=clamp_u8(ffff22fe+ffff22f8-(ffff1657>>4)).
note: Both compositor branches of 0004bdc2 subtract the result in crank degrees.

semantics: Retard-difference producer. It evaluates a curve of ffff11b3 into ffff12da and a curve of ffff106f into ffff12d9 and writes ffff12dc=max(ffff12da-ffff12d9,0).
note: The normal compositor branch of 0004bdc2 subtracts the result in crank degrees.

semantics: Nonvolatile timing-offset store. When the ffff41ab.bit7 latch is set it copies ffff56b2 into ffff29c6, records identifier 0x74 in ffff2cd6, and places the word in ffff2ce2 for the configuration-record writer.
note: The stored offset is restored by 000686b8 from record 0x74 and re-enters the timing sum through 0004aad0 within -5..0 crank degrees.

semantics: Retard-request producer. It writes ffff11f9=0 when (ffff4242&0x30)!=0; otherwise min(max(hi(ffff2336),hi(ffff235e)),127) while ffff24cb.bit5 is clear, or the ffff2025-adjusted variant when it is set. It also writes ffff2015.

semantics: Rate-limited follower of ffff2363. It moves ffff11e7 toward ffff2363 by at most ROM8[0x845d]=5 counts per call, saturating at 0 and 255.
note: Scheduler 00020dfe snapshots ffff11e7 into ffff11af, the threshold subtracted from the low-seven timing-map field in 0004af38. Engine-event dispatcher 0004e162 calls it before 0004d99c.

semantics: Throttle-position sensor 1 range monitor for both channels. It reads ffff2756 and ffff2758, accepts ROM16[0x9550]=60..ROM16[0x954e]=964 counts inclusive, and dispatches exact JK08A descriptor indices 0xe6 and 0xe7 for P0223 and P0222 and 0x111 and 0x112 for P2133 and P2132.
note: The exact ROM descriptor catalog identifies the four indices as throttle position sensor 1 circuit high and low input for banks 1 and 2. At 5 mV per count the window is 0.30..4.82 V, which brackets the factory terminal criteria of more than 0.36 V released and less than 4.75 V depressed.

semantics: Throttle-position sensor 2 range monitor for both channels. It reads ffff275e and ffff2760, accepts ROM16[0x9550]=60..ROM16[0x954e]=964 counts inclusive, and dispatches exact JK08A descriptor indices 0xe8 and 0xe9 for P0123 and P0122 and 0x113 and 0x114 for P0228 and P0227.
note: The exact ROM descriptor catalog identifies the four indices as throttle position sensor 2 circuit high and low input for banks 1 and 2. Both sensor-2 words are published on the sensor-1 scale, so they share the limits of 000a7418.

semantics: Sample collector of the MAF coefficient calibration sequence. While state byte ffff2985 is 1 it requires snapshot ffff1a3e to lie within ROM8[0x8d3e]*4=856..ROM8[0x8d3f]*4=944 counts, adds it to accumulator ffff3524, and advances the state to 2 after eight accepted samples. An out-of-range sample clears coefficient ffff4970 and aborts to state 3.
note: The accepted window is 4.28..4.72 V at 5 mV per count, a symmetric band around the 900-count design point of the sequence.

semantics: Coefficient stage of the MAF calibration sequence. At state 2 it divides ROM8[0x8d40]=225 shifted left by twenty by accumulator ffff3524, saturates the quotient to 0xffff, and stores it in ffff4970 when it lies within ROM8[0x87f9]<<8=0x7900..ROM8[0x87f8]<<8=0x8700; otherwise it stores zero. It then advances the state to 3.
note: An eight-sample average of 900 counts returns stock coefficient 0x8000, so the design point of the sequence is 4.50 V at 5 mV per count.

semantics: Import step of the MAF coefficient. At state byte ffff2985 equal to 7 it reads configuration key 0x7f through stable wrapper 0006727c, stores the result in ffff4970, and advances the state to 0 when the value lies within ROM8[0x87f9]<<8=0x7900..ROM8[0x87f8]<<8=0x8700 or to 8 otherwise.
note: Sibling step 000686b8 imports keys 0x74 and 0x7e through the same wrapper. Together with calibration stage 0006635c this closes the lifecycle of non-stock in-range coefficients.

semantics: Injection-duration array filler for the ATU-II one-shot scheduler. It writes six words at ffff224e. When ffff418c.bit1 is set or ffff24a0.bit6 is clear it fills all six from injector opening time ffff23aa. Otherwise parameter 0 fills them from ffff238a; parameters 1, 2, and 4 form uint16(ffff23aa)+(ROM16[000094e8]*100>>8), compare it with ffff2388, conditionally subtract ffff238a from ffff2386, and lower-bound the result at ffff238c, ffff238e, or ffff2392; any other parameter copies snapshot ffff2348+2*i with a lower bound at ffff2390. It then calls FUN 000571c0 when ROM8[00008d92] bit 3 is set.
note: All four branches write the same six-word array, whose counts are 10 us. The three functions that pass ffff224e to FUN 0002c13c call this filler first, so the array is refreshed on every scheduling pass. The physical identity of start words ffff2386..ffff2392 remains unresolved.

semantics: CAN torque-word packer reached from FUN 00079de4 through the trampoline at 0007a050. It converts scheduler latches of the torque chain and of the signed request boundary to 12-bit CAN words clamp(trunc0(x/5)+800, 0, 4094): ffff3fa0 from ffff4106, ffff3f90 from ffff4108, ffff3f9c from ffff237c+ffff2384, ffff3f96 from ffff2380, and ffff3f98 from max(min(ffff23a8,ffff2382),ffff2374). It writes invalid code 4095 to ffff3f96 and ffff3f98 while ffff4221.bit2 is set, stores the complement of ffff40d2 in ffff3d6e, and derives the two-bit status codes ffff3e89, ffff3d3f, and ffff3d3e.
note: FUN 00079de4 is entry 58 of the 69-entry pending-task table at 00021834. Serializers 000c577a and 000c590e are the only readers of the packed words.

semantics: CAN 0x180 payload serializer for software record 7. Bytes 0..1 are sat_u16(u16[ffff11ee]*25); byte 2 and byte 3 bits 7..4 are actual-torque word ffff3f96; byte 3 bits 3..0 and byte 4 are requested-torque word ffff3f90; byte 5 and byte 6 bits 7..6 are min(u16[ffff279c],1000); byte 6 bits 5 and 4 copy ffff4246 bits 5 and 4; byte 6 bits 3..0 are ffff3d3a&15; byte 7 bits 7..5 are ffff4104; byte 7 bit 4 is ffff4248.bit7; byte 7 bit 2 is ffff4196.bit4 and bits 1..0 hold 1 while that bit or ffff2451.bit7 is set.

semantics: CAN 0x160 payload serializer for software record 8. Byte 0 and byte 1 bits 7..4 are limited-request word ffff3fa0; byte 1 bits 3..0 and byte 2 are parallel actual-torque word ffff3f98; byte 3 and byte 4 bits 7..6 are ten-bit word ffff40d2; byte 5 and byte 6 bits 7..6 are its complement ffff3d6e; byte 4 carries ffff421f.bit1, ffff424f.bit3, ffff2459.bit5, and ffff3d3f&3; byte 6 carries ffff4242.bit3, ffff2482.bit0, ffff3e89&3, and ffff3d3e&3.

semantics: Net engine-torque builder. It stores the inhibited-cylinder count from FUN 00065d42 at ffff16a2 and writes ffff18d0=sat_i16(trunc0(s16[ffff18ce]*(6-n)/6)-u16[ffff2408]-u16[ffff14e2]).
note: FUN 00065d42 returns 6 for fuel-output inhibit mask ffff22e0=0x3f and at least 3 for mask 0x15.

semantics: First-order filter of the net engine-torque state. It writes ffff18d2=trunc0((s16[ffff18d0]*w+s16[ffff18d2]*(256-w))/256) with w=ROM8[000087ed] and adds one count when the result equals the previous value below the input.
Accessory-load subtraction stage. It writes ffff240c=sat_i16(s16[ffff18d2]-u16[ffff2410]), the net engine torque that CAN frame 0x180 carries.
note: FUN 00065e54, entry 96 of the periodic table at 0002196c, calls 00065b08, 00065cd8, 00065de4, 00065f9c, and this function.

semantics: Accessory-load torque sum. It runs FUN 00065e98, FUN 00065efa, and FUN 00065f42, then writes ffff2410=sat_u16(u16[ffff1818]+u16[ffff196e]+u16[ffff1838]), or zero while byte ffff11b3 is zero.
Parallel-channel accessory-load subtraction stage. It runs FUN 000655b4, FUN 0006570c, and FUN 00065764, then writes ffff240e=sat_i16(s16[ffff18d8]-u16[ffff2410]), the source of CAN word ffff3f98.

Fuel-temperature sample filter and transfer stage, called from publisher 00039788. It filters AN0 mux code 111 sample ffff100a through 0003a5e0 with state word ffff1fa8 and status byte ffff1f87, stores the filtered word in ffff1fa8 at 00039826 and uint8(word >> 2) in ffff1178 at 0003982e, converts that byte through shared table 00012dea via implicit-axis primitive 000263a0 at 00039832, and writes transfer code ffff1f89 at 0003983a. It copies two filter result flags to ffff24bd bit 6 and ffff24b6 bit 4.
note: Oil-temperature producer 0003eb84 applies the same filter, shift, and lookup sequence to its own sample. The transfer code is deg C+50, as the ECU declares for table 00012dea through J1979 Mode 01 PIDs 0x05 and 0x0F.

semantics: Periodic fuel-temperature publisher for DID 0x1104 byte ffff1074, entry 27 of periodic table 00021834. It calls filter and transfer stage 000397e8 and stores at 000397c4 either service-0x30 value byte ffff992d while active bit ffff99c5 bit 1 is set or the output of limiter 00039874 with ffff24b8 bit 5 cleared. The limiter compares transfer code ffff1f89 with ffff107c, the previous-pass copy of ffff1074 that dispatcher 000209d8 makes through the eight-byte block ffff1072..ffff1079 -> ffff107a..ffff1081 at 00020cba: it returns a higher code at once, holds the previous byte while code + 2 exceeds it, and otherwise returns code + 2. Validity helper 00039896 returns 1 on every path, so the branch that sets ffff24b8 bit 5 is unreachable. The function then calls 000398b0 to form normalized index ffff117a and writes ffff1073 at 000397d8: the current byte while gate 00039902 returns 1, otherwise its previous-pass copy ffff107b. The gate returns 1 and clears latch ffff24bd bit 5 while computed START SIGNAL ffff4185 bit 6 is set and battery byte ffff1188 is below 100; outside that condition it sets a clear latch and returns 1 once, then returns 0.
note: Value byte ffff992d and active bit ffff99c5 bit 1 occupy the IOLID-0x0a positions of the service-0x30 arrays, in which IOLID 0x0c holds ffff992f and ffff99c5 bit 3. The published byte is deg C+50, the code of table 00012dea; on a falling temperature the limiter keeps it between the converted sample and the sample plus two counts. ffff1073 holds the fuel temperature of the first pass after the start and low-voltage condition ends, the gate structure that selector 0003967a applies to coolant.

semantics: Normalized fuel-temperature index producer. It reads ffff1074 and writes ffff117a at 000398f8: 0 below raw 10, floor(240*(raw-10)/150) through unsigned divider 00021bbc for raw 10..169, and 0xff from raw 170.
note: The transform equals coolant normalizer 00039634. Under deg C+50 the linear range maps -40 through 110 deg C to 0 through 240 in steps of 1.6 counts per deg C, and values from 120 deg C saturate to 255.

semantics: Engine-oil-temperature circuit coordinator. While ROM8[0x18701] bit 1 is set it reports descriptor 0xdd (P0197) through 0007d8b8 when ffff4184 bit 6 is clear, ffff41c8 bit 7 is set, snapshot ffff10fb of oil input byte ffff117b is below 3, and countdown ffff438d, reloaded to 50 while the condition is false, has reached zero. While ROM8[0x18701] bit 0 is set it reports descriptor 0xde (P0198) on the same terms for an input byte of 242 or above with countdown ffff438c. While ROM8[0x18702] bit 2 is set it calls rationality monitors 00099efe and 0009a0d4; the stock byte 0xf9 leaves the bit clear, so JK08A skips both. With ffff4184 bit 7 clear and ffff4186 bit 7 set it latches coolant snapshot ffff1071 into ffff5508 at 00099ef0.
note: The input limits are below 0.06 V and from 4.84 V at 20 mV per input count, and producer 0003eb84 publishes 0xff outside the same 3..241 range. Descriptor records 0xdd, 0xde, and 0xe4 at 00019360 + 12*index carry P0197, P0198, and P0196.

semantics: P0196 stuck-low rationality monitor of the engine oil temperature, called from 00099e00 only while ROM8[0x18702] bit 2 is set, which stock JK08A leaves clear. While ffff244f bit 5 is set and coolant snapshot ffff1071 exceeds ROM8[0x8cd9]=100 it counts ffff84c3 bit 6 ticks in ffff3190 and sets ffff41f1 bit 7 from ROM16[0x936a]=300 ticks; countdown ffff449e, reloaded from ROM16[0x936e]=300 while ffff244f bit 5 is set, clears the counter and the flag when it expires. While ffff4184 bit 7 is set it tracks minimum ffff344c and maximum ffff344b of oil snapshot ffff2772. With ffff41c8 bit 7 set, zero results of fault predicates 000259e4 and 00025a12 for the checked indices, ffff41f1 bit 7 set, battery snapshot ffff1108 above 137, and ffff4206 bit 0 clear, an oil byte below ROM8[0x8962]=50 with maximum - minimum below ROM8[0x8963]=6 reports descriptor 0xe4 through 0007d8b8 once countdown ffff449c, reloaded from ROM16[0x936c]=10 otherwise, has reached zero, and sets ffff4206 bit 0.
note: Under deg C+50 and 0.08 V per battery count the constants read: coolant above 50 deg C for 300 ticks, battery above 10.96 V, oil below 0 deg C, and an oil span below 6 deg C. The factory confirmation procedure asks for battery voltage of more than 11 V and an idle period of 5 minutes and 10 seconds.

semantics: P0196 soak-comparison rationality monitor of the engine oil temperature, called from 00099e00 only while ROM8[0x18702] bit 2 is set, which stock JK08A leaves clear. While ffff4184 bit 7 and ffff244f bit 5 are set it counts ffff84c3 bit 6 ticks in ffff3192 and sets ffff41f1 bit 6 above ROM16[0x9370]=300. The enable chain requires ffff41c8 bit 7 set, zero results of fault predicates 000259e4 and 00025a12 for the checked indices, coolant latch ffff5508 of at least ROM8[0x8cda]=130, selected-temperature snapshot ffff106e and second temperature byte ffff452c both at most ROM8[0x8cdb]=90, and their absolute difference through 00022590 below ROM8[0x8cc9]=6; otherwise it clears pass counter ffff3194. With the chain satisfied, oil snapshot ffff2772 above ROM8[0x8964]=170, ffff244f bit 5 set, ffff41f1 bit 6 clear, battery snapshot ffff1108 above 137, and ffff4206 bit 0 clear, it counts ticks in ffff3194 and from ROM16[0x9372]=300 reports descriptor 0xe4 through 0007d8b8, increments saturating word ffff54f0, and sets ffff4206 bit 0.
note: Under deg C+50 the constants are the factory confirmation procedure: coolant above 80 deg C before the soak, coolant and intake air below 40 deg C, and a difference within 6 deg C; the oil limit of 170 is 120 deg C, and the 300-tick count stands against a factory idle period of 5 minutes. The procedure identifies the second byte as intake air temperature: ffff452c is the scheduler snapshot of ffff454c, which FUN 0003d832 copies from ffff5610 at 0003d894, and the reference scan holds no writer of ffff5610. Battery byte 137 is 10.96 V against the factory condition of more than 11 V.
